title: Mortgage Loan Officer - Private Credit (Remote, US Hours)
description:
About Us

Manhattan Global Partners (MGP) is a family office headquartered at One World Trade Center, New York. Through MGP Private Credit Fund we provide business-purpose real estate and private credit financing, including lease-with-option-to-purchase structures, across 44 U.S. states. We are growing fast and need a sharp, reliable loan officer to help manage our deal flow from first inquiry to closing.



The Role

You will be the first point of contact for brokers and borrowers, qualify new loan requests, collect and organize documents, and prepare clean deal packages for our credit team. This is a full-time remote role working U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Responsibilities

- Respond quickly to new loan inquiries from brokers and borrowers by
, phone, WhatsApp and our CRM

- Pre-qualify deals against MGP lending criteria (property type, LTV, borrower profile, exit strategy)

- Request, collect and review borrower documents: bank statements, entity docs, purchase contracts, appraisals, title, insurance, rent rolls

- Build loan files and deal summaries / term sheet drafts for credit review

- Run basic underwriting numbers: LTV, LTC, DSCR, cash flow and repayment analysis

- Track every deal in the pipeline and follow up so nothing goes cold

- Coordinate with title companies, appraisers, attorneys and closing agents through to funding

- Maintain broker relationships and keep the CRM accurate and up to date



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience in U.S. mortgage, hard money, private lending or commercial real estate lending (loan processing, underwriting or loan officer support)

- Strong understanding of U.S. real estate loan documents and terminology (LTV, DSCR, title, escrow, appraisal, closing)

- Excellent written and spoken English - you will speak directly with U.S. brokers and borrowers

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills; CRM experience is a plus

- Highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable managing many deals at once

- Available to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace and a backup power/internet plan



Nice to Have

- Experience with fix-and-flip, bridge, DSCR rental or commercial loans

- Experience with private credit funds or alternative lenders

- Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce or similar CRMs

title: Booking Coordinator and Virtual Assistant
description:
mportant Work Environment Disclosure



Please read this section carefully before applying. We want to be transparent about what this role is like so that there are no surprises after you are hired.



This is a high-volume, fast-paced position. The workload can be extremely heavy, and there may be times when a large amount of information, messages, bookings, and instructions come in at once.



You may need to:



• Read and process a lot of information quickly

• Manage multiple conversations at the same time

• Switch between different tasks throughout your shift

• Remember and follow multiple instructions

• Prioritize urgent requests

• Keep track of details while working quickly

• Learn new procedures and systems as they are introduced

• Handle periods of very high activity without becoming overwhelmed



Regular Feedback & Corrections



Regular feedback is a normal and important part of this role.



Because we work quickly and handle a high volume of clients and bookings, you will receive frequent feedback, corrections, and reminders, especially while you are learning the position.



We may ask you to change how you are completing a task, correct an error, follow a different procedure, or improve your response time.



This is not meant to be personal or negative. Our goal is to help you learn the role, improve your performance, and maintain a high standard of service.



You should be comfortable receiving constructive feedback and making adjustments quickly.



If you prefer a role with very little feedback, few corrections, or minimal oversight, this position may not be the right fit for you.



A Lot of Information Will Be Introduced



There is a lot to learn in this position. During training and throughout your time with us, you will receive new information, procedures, scripts, systems, and instructions.



You are not expected to remember everything immediately.



However, we do expect you to:



• Take notes

• Review training materials

• Ask questions when something is unclear

• Make a genuine effort to remember instructions

• Apply previous feedback to future situations

• Become more independent as you gain experience



We understand that learning takes time. What matters most to us is that you are willing to learn, responsive to feedback, and consistently improving.



Please Apply If You Enjoy:



• Fast-paced work

• Staying busy throughout your shift

• Learning new things

• Solving problems

• Multitasking

• Receiving feedback and improving

• Taking initiative

• Working as part of a team

• Having a role where every day can be different



We are looking for someone who enjoys being busy and takes pride in keeping things organized, even when there is a lot happening at once.

title: Remote Construction Project Administrator
description:
Remote Construction

Project Administrator

Philippines-based | U.S. commercial construction experience required | Long-term opportunity



DTS COMPANY is an established union commercial tile and stone contractor serving  California for

more than 16 years. We are seeking a dependable, experienced remote professional to keep construction

documents, bidding and project administration organized and moving. This is not a general virtual assistant

position.

You should already have experience supporting a U.S. commercial general contractor or specialty

subcontractor. We will teach you our specific processes, but you should know the basic language and workflow

of construction



Responsibilities

• Bid coordination: Monitor RFPs, RFQs and bid invitations; download plans, specifications and addenda; capture

deadlines and build complete digital bid packages.

• Quantifier coordination: Send the complete scope to our existing takeoff specialist; receive, organize and check

the returned quantities for management review. You do not perform takeoffs.

• Proposals and vendor quotations: Assemble proposals for approval; request pricing, availability and lead times;

follow up and compare received quotations.

• Daily reports: Collect foremen’s field reports; file them by job and date; summarize work completed, manpower,

deliveries, delays and outstanding issues.

• Project records: Maintain current project folders, PDFs, drawings, RFI/submittal/change-order logs and related

correspondence.

• Construction billings: Prepare draft AIA G702/G703 billings, schedules of values, retention/retainage tracking,

change-order support and OH&P calculations.

• Vendor invoices: Track vendor, job, invoice number, purpose, amount, due date and status; pass organized

supporting documents to our existing bookkeeper.

• Reporting: Maintain useful Excel trackers, provide concise status updates, and flag items needing management

title: Video Editor
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a talented Creative Video Editor with a sharp eye for design and a passion for storytelling. This is not just a "cutter" role; we need a visual artist who can elevate raw footage into compelling content.



The ideal candidate is a creative chameleon: you must be comfortable switching gears between high-energy, fast-paced Influencer content (TikTok/Reels) and polished, trustworthy, and professional Medical/Corporate content.



The Challenge: Two Worlds, One Editor

To succeed in this role, you must master two distinct styles:



The "Viral" Style: Fast cuts, trending audio, meme integration, dynamic subtitles, and high-retention editing techniques for our influencer and lifestyle clients.



The "Premium" Style: Clean typography, smooth transitions, color grading, and perfect audio balancing for our medical and aesthetic clients (where trust and elegance are key).



Key Responsibilities

1. Video Editing & Post-Production

End-to-End Editing: Take raw footage sent to you and assemble it into polished final deliverables for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Ads.



Retention Editing: Utilize visual hooks, pattern interrupts, and pacing techniques to keep viewers watching until the end.



Audio Engineering: Expert selection of background music, sound effects (SFX), and audio cleaning (removing background noise/echo) to ensure professional sound quality.



2. Design & Motion Graphics

Visual Polish: Use your "creative eye" to design aesthetic text overlays, lower thirds, and on-screen graphics. We don’t want generic subtitles; we want designed typography.



Color Grading: Correct color imbalances to ensure skin tones look healthy (crucial for medical clients) and visuals pop.



Thumbnail Design: Create eye-catching cover images/thumbnails for video reels.



3. Creative Collaboration

Storyboarding: Assist in visualizing how a script will look on screen before we shoot.



Trend Spotting: Stay updated on the latest editing trends, trending audio, and visual effects on TikTok/IG Reels and proactively suggest them to the team.



Requirements & Skills

Portfolio (Non-Negotiable): A showreel or portfolio demonstrating a range of work—specifically showing ability in both fast-paced social content AND slower, polished professional content.



Software Mastery:



Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (for heavy lifting).



Proficiency in After Effects (for motion graphics/design).



Familiarity with CapCut (for rapid, trend-based edits).



Design Sense: Strong understanding of typography, layout, and color theory. You know how to make text look "expensive" versus "fun."



Attention to Detail: You spot the single frame of black screen, the slightly out-of-sync audio, or the typo in the subtitles before anyone else does.



Speed & Organization: Ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously and meet deadlines without compromising quality.





How to Apply

Please submit your Resume and a Link to your Portfolio/Showreel. Note: Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

title: Lead Research Specialist (Influencers, Brands & Online Communities)

We are a company specializing in custom plush toy production, working with creators, brands, games, and online communities worldwide.



We are looking for someone who can research and find strong creators and communities for potential plush collaborations.





========================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

========================================



Your job is to find creators, brands, games, and online communities that could realistically become successful plush products.



This is NOT just about finding large creators.



We are specifically looking for creators with:



- Recognizable mascots, avatars, characters, creatures, memes, or other visual identities

- Strong and active communities

- Clear potential for a plush product

- Enough audience and buying potential for a successful product



The most important question is:



“Would fans realistically buy this as a plush product?”





========================================

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

========================================



A good lead MUST meet these requirements:



1. The creator must be ACTIVE

No dead channels, abandoned accounts, or creators with long upload breaks.



2. The creator/community must have enough buying potential

The audience should be large and engaged enough that selling 200+ plush units is realistically possible.



3. The creator should NOT already sell plush merchandise

We are specifically looking for creators who currently do not already sell plush products.



4. There must be a strong plush concept

The creator must have at least one of the following:

- Mascot

- Avatar

- Inside joke

- Character

- Meme

- Creature

- Recognizable visual identity



And it must be something that could realistically be turned into a strong and appealing plush product.



We are NOT looking for:

- Generic influencers with no recognizable visual identity

- Inactive creators

- Tiny communities with no buying potential

- Random gaming creators with no mascot/character potential





========================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

========================================



- Research creators, brands, games, and communities

- Find strong plush collaboration opportunities

-Identifying the specific mascot, character, avatar, meme, creature, or visual identity that could become a plush

- Evaluating whether the community has realistic potential to buy the product

- Collect contact details/socials

- Organizing your research and findings clearly





========================================

REQUIREMENTS

========================================



- Good internet research skills

- Understanding of online communities and creator culture

- An understanding of YouTube, gaming, and content creators

- Attention to detail

- Good English communication skills

-The ability to recognize opportunities beyond simple follower counts





========================================

WORK DETAILS

========================================



- 4 hours per day

- Flexible schedule





========================================

HOW TO APPLY

========================================



Please include:



1. Short introduction

2. Relevant experience

3. Contact information 
 etc.)



IMPORTANT:

Please include 3 SAMPLE LEADS you personally researched.



For EACH sample lead include:



- Who they are

- Links/socials media

- WHAT specifically could become the plush

- WHY fans would likely buy it

- WHY the community is a strong fit



Weak answers:

“Big creator”, “gaming audience”, “popular community”



Strong answers:

Specific mascot/avatar/character ideas with clear collectible and fandom appeal.

title: Bilingual Booking Assistant (English & Korean): Instagram DMs & Email Client Bookings for a Seoul Tattoo Studio (Full-Ti
description:
About us

We're a fine-line tattoo studio in Seoul with about 94K followers on Instagram and 76K on TikTok. Many of our clients are international travelers planning a trip to Korea, and nearly all bookings start as an Instagram DM or a form on our website. We handle about 15 new bookings a day, with 50–100 in progress at any time.



The role

You'll be the first person our clients talk to. You'll answer their questions, quote prices, collect deposits, and make sure every booking is complete and correct before it reaches our artists. Once a booking is confirmed, you'll write up the client's design for our artists in Korean. You'll be trained by our senior booking assistant, following a detailed written playbook.



What you'll do

• Reply to Instagram DMs and booking
s in a warm, personal tone, not copy-paste

• Collect each client's details: flash or custom design, size, placement, color, dates, and references

• Quote prices from our price sheet and send deposit instructions

• Check deposit screenshots against payment notifications

• Follow up with clients who go quiet after a quote

• Assign bookings to artists by availability and add them to our shared Google Calendar

• Once a deposit is confirmed, write the Artist Notes in Korean in our shared Google Doc: the client's design, tentative placement and approximate size, then let the artist know in KakaoTalk

    ◦ Flash designs: record the design in our standard format, so the artist knows exactly which one the client wants

    ◦ Custom designs: translate the client's ideas, references and needs into clear Korean so the artist can draw a first draft. Relay what the client said; don't reinterpret it

• Write pricing notes our studio team uses for final invoices

• Send design drafts to clients, collect revision requests, and confirm designs 24 hours before each session

• Send prep info (pricing scale, directions, payment methods) to confirmed clients

• Keep our lead tracker up to date

• Pass unusual pricing, refund or reschedule requests to the owners



Must have

• Excellent written English with a friendly, natural customer-service tone

• Strong written Korean (reading and writing). Our artists don't speak English and rely on your notes to draw

• Customer service or sales experience over chat or

• Strong attention to detail, especially with prices, dates and names

• Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets)

• Reliable internet and a quiet place to work



Nice to have

• Booking experience for a tattoo studio, salon, spa or other appointment-based business

• Experience managing a brand's Instagram inbox

• Experience translating between English and Korean

• Familiarity with Korean culture or K-pop



How we work

• Full-time, with working hours set in Seoul time (Manila is one hour behind)

• Fast replies matter: clients book with whoever answers first

• Access to our Instagram DMs is given through Meta Business Suite

• Chat is our main channel for team communication. No all-day video calls

• An end-of-day message on bookings handled and anything waiting

• Hours are logged with a time-tracking app



Pay: DOE (depends on experience). Paid via Wise



How to apply

Send a short introduction, your expected rate, your Korean level (reading and writing), and your answer to the screening question below. Applications that don't answer it won't be reviewed. Shortlisted applicants will do a paid trial task.



Screening Question

Start your application with the word "Fineline". Then write the exact reply you would send to this Instagram DM:

"hiii how much is a small tattoo?? im visiting seoul in december with my friend!!"

A strong answer is warm and personal, asks for the details needed to quote (design, size, placement, dates), mentions booking with a friend, and doesn't make up a price.

Second, please translate the following line to Korean as if you were explaining it to a Korean artist who needs to draw a design: "I want the cat to look more cute, and it would be nice if we could add some sparkles or twinkles. For the colored bits can we make it look like watercolor?"

title: Dental Insurance & Billing Specialist
description:
Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics | Remote



Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time

Reports to: ROC Team Leader



About Us

Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics is a growing dental group in Los Angeles, California, with four offices offering general dentistry and orthodontics to kids, teens, and adults. Our Remote Operations Coordinators (ROCs) work behind the scenes as the Office Manager’s best partner, with one goal: maximize production and collections so our teams can focus on patients.



About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-driven insurance and billing specialist to join our ROC team. You’ll make sure every patient has verified coverage before they walk in, every visit is billed right the first time, every payment lands in the right place, and every ortho account stays accurate from banding to retention. You’ll work across PPO and Denti-Cal (Medi-Cal Dental), for both general dentistry and orthodontics.



What You’ll Own



Eligibility and benefit breakdowns



Verify Denti-Cal and PPO eligibility for scheduled patients ahead of their visits, and flag anyone without active coverage

Build accurate PPO benefit breakdowns in Open Dental (maximums, deductibles, frequencies, waiting periods, coverage percentages, and ortho benefits such as lifetime maximums, age limits, and payment frequency)

Prepare routing slips 2 days ahead so insurance details match the schedule, and check the schedule throughout the day for newly added appointments

Keep patient insurance information clean and current (subscriber details, plan updates, coordination of benefits)

Alert the office and call center to inactive, terminated, or changed coverage so patients can be contacted before their visit



Payment posting and account accuracy



Post PPO and Denti-Cal insurance payments (EOBs/ERAs) quickly and accurately, and keep patient ledgers clean and balanced

Post 
 payments and keep payment records clean

Upload and attach eligibility and supporting documentation to the correct patient charts and claims



Orthodontic billing



Submit and track orthodontic insurance claims for PPO patients (initial banding, monthly/periodic billing, retention)

Monitor ortho payment plans and patient balances, and flag missed payments or discrepancies

Learn our Denti-Cal ortho process over time (we’ll train you)



Claims follow-up and audits



Work denials, rejections, and aging AR; follow up with carriers and submit appeals when needed

Audit claims and balances proactively so errors are caught early, not “fixed later”

Double-check Denti-Cal and PPO policies to prevent denials and appeals

Keep clear notes in Open Dental, close every loop with the offices, and escalate chart, billing, or documentation issues quickly and clearly



What Good Looks Like (our READY standard)



Routing Slips Prepared: Every patient’s eligibility is verified before they arrive, and routing slips match the schedule so the office can execute immediately.

Ensure Schedule & Record Accuracy: Extreme attention to detail. Insurance and billing information is entered correctly and readable for the office.

Audit & Bill Daily: Breakdowns are accurate, claims are correct, balances make sense, and errors are caught early.

Dedicated to the Office: Strong ownership mindset. You keep a running task list, close loops with confirmation, and take work off the manager’s plate.

Yield Maximum Production: Fewer eligibility surprises, fewer denials, fewer billing mistakes, and no production left on the table.



Requirements



2+ years of US dental insurance experience, including eligibility verification, benefit breakdowns, and payment posting (PPO required)

US orthodontic billing experience and a strong understanding of how ortho insurance pays over the course of treatment

Experience working denials, appeals, and AR follow-up with US carriers

Comfortable with payer portals and phone verifications

Excellent written and spoken English

Able to work ahead of the schedule and manage high daily volume without sacrificing accuracy

Proactive and dependable in a remote setting: you close loops and confirm your work

Reliable computer, fast stable internet, and a quiet workspace with backup power and internet

Available to work US Pacific Time hours



Nice to Have



Denti-Cal/Medi-Cal experience (strong plus)

Open Dental experience

Experience with patient financing or payment plan platforms such as 

A dental nerd at heart who wants to understand not just the “what” but the “why” behind our policies



Why Join Us



Long-term, stable full-time role

Paid training with a supportive, experienced team



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume

A short summary of your dental insurance and ortho billing experience (practices, software used, typical daily volume)

title: Marketing Systems and Campaign Operations Specialist
description:
COMMERCIAL REAL ESTATE BROKERAGE | LOS ANGELES, CA



Marketing Systems and Campaign Operations Specialist



GoHighLevel | 30 hours per week | Remote | Long term



About us



We are an established commercial real estate brokerage in Los Angeles, California, with over two decades in the market and more than $1 billion in closed transactions across five verticals. We run a large owner database and a high volume of outbound campaigns. Our entire marketing and lead engine lives inside GoHighLevel.



We are hiring one person to own that engine and the marketing production that feeds it. This is a direct, long term hire with our firm, not an agency placement and not a short project. We will share the company name with candidates we move forward with.



The role, in two parts



This is a single role with two halves. We need both. Please do not apply if you can only do one.



Part one: GoHighLevel and campaign operations, about 20 hours a week



You are the administrator and operator of our GoHighLevel instance.



● Workflows, automations, triggers, tags, smart lists, pipelines, custom fields and user permissions



●
 and SMS campaigns against roughly 50,000 contacts: segmentation, batch scheduling, send calendars, suppression and do not disturb management



● A2P 10DLC registration and tier management, sender reputation, bounce and spam handling, carrier filtering, number provisioning, warming and rotation



● Ringless voi
 campaigns through Slybroadcast, including reading delivery reports and diagnosing failures



● Call tracking and routing through CallRail, and the integration between those tools and GoHighLevel



● List hygiene: imports, field mapping, deduplication and record integrity



● One weekly report on campaign performance and deliverability health, in a consistent format, without being asked for it



Part two: marketing production, about 10 hours a week



You build the materials the campaigns send.



● Broker opinion of value and offering memorandum assembly from our templates



● Property flyers and eblasts, built in Canva and sent through GoHighLevel



● Comparable sales pulls and basic market research



● Proofreading and quality control before anything goes out with our name on it



● Keeping the marketing file library organized so anyone on the team can find a property in under a minute



We use Claude and ChatGPT to speed this half of the job up. If you are already comfortable using AI tools for drafting and document assembly, say so.



What we require



● Hands on GoHighLevel experience as an administrator or agency operator. Not just clicking through a build somebody else made.



● Direct experience with A2P 10DLC registration and SMS deliverability. This is the single most important technical requirement.



● Experience running
 and SMS campaigns at scale, in the tens of thousands of contacts.



● Excellent written English. You will write to us, to vendors, and sometimes to our clients.



● Reliable overlap with Pacific Time business hours and a consistent daily start time.



● A bias toward moving work forward on your own. When you have no assigned task, you say so the same day and propose what you should be working on.



Preferred



● GoHighLevel certification. Certified Admin or equivalent is strongly preferred.



● We will pay for GoHighLevel certification training for the right candidate. If you have real hands on GHL experience but no formal certification, apply anyway and tell us.



● Commercial real estate, brokerage or professional services marketing background



● Slybroadcast, CallRail, Constant Contact, WordPress or Canva experience



● Comfort with Claude or ChatGPT for drafting and document work



How we work



● 30 hours a week on a set, consistent schedule



● Time tracking software and a short daily log of what you worked on



● You reply to messages within one hour during your working hours



● Tasks are expected to take about as long as a competent operator would need, and we review that



● Direct access to the owner. Decisions get made quickly and you will not sit waiting for approvals.



Compensation



$5 to $12 per hour, depending on demonstrated GoHighLevel depth and certification status. We pay at the top of that range for people who need less supervision, and we will fund GoHighLevel certification for the right person. This is a long term engagement, not a project.



To apply



Send a short note and answer these five questions. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.



1. Walk us through the last A2P 10DLC registration you completed. What tier did you land on, what was the monthly volume cap, and what did you do when messages started getting filtered?



2. We have roughly 50,000 contacts and a messaging cap well below a full database send. How would you structure a campaign calendar around that?



3. Describe a GoHighLevel workflow you built from scratch. What was the trigger, what were the branches, and what did it replace?



4. A ringless voi
 campaign comes back with a high rate of "unable to detect voi
" failures. What is your first diagnostic step and what is your likely fix?



5. Send one marketing piece you built yourself: a flyer, an eblast or a one page property summary. It does not need to be real estate.



Finalists will be asked to complete a short paid trial: take one property flyer and produce an eblast and an SMS draft from it.



Commercial real estate brokerage | Los Angeles, California | Remote role, Pacific Time overlap required

title: AI Business Automation & Process Optimization Specialist

Industry: Healthcare, Pharmacy & Wellness

Salary: To Be Discussed (Based on Experience)



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, highly analytical, and solutions-driven AI Business Automation & Process Optimization Specialist to help us identify operational inefficiencies, streamline workflows, and implement AI-powered solutions across our businesses operating in Australia and New Zealand.



We are not simply looking for someone who knows how to use ChatGPT or other AI tools. We need someone who can understand how a business operates, identify what is slowing it down, and design and implement practical AI-driven solutions that improve productivity, reduce costs, minimise manual work, and accelerate business growth.



Our operations span multiple departments, including administration, customer service, clinical operations, pharmacy, sales, marketing, IT, finance, and project management.



Your primary responsibility will be to assess our existing business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and build AI-powered workflows, automation systems, and tools that make our operations smarter, faster, more efficient, and scalable.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who can take a business problem, develop a solution, implement it, and measure its impact.



Key Responsibilities



1. Business Process Analysis & Optimization



Conduct a comprehensive review of existing business processes, workflows, and operational systems.



Work closely with management and department heads to understand daily operations and identify inefficiencies.



Identify repetitive manual tasks, process bottlenecks, duplicated work, and opportunities for automation.



Map existing workflows and recommend improvements to reduce operational costs and improve productivity.



Prioritise automation opportunities based on business impact, feasibility, implementation cost, and return on investment.



Develop actionable recommendations and implementation roadmaps.



2. AI Strategy Development & Implementation



Develop an AI adoption and automation strategy aligned with our business goals.



Identify the most suitable AI tools, platforms, and technologies for different departments.



Design and implement AI-powered solutions to improve operational efficiency and decision-making.



Develop AI-assisted workflows for administration, customer service, sales, marketing, finance, and other business functions.



Evaluate opportunities to integrate AI into existing business software and systems.



Recommend practical, scalable, and cost-effective AI solutions.



Continuously research emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for business improvement.



3. Workflow Automation & Systems Integration



Build automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Microsoft Power Automate, or similar platforms.



Integrate existing software, databases, communication platforms, and business applications.



Develop automated processes for data entry, reporting, customer communications, task management, and administrative workflows.



Create AI-powered assistants, internal knowledge bases, and productivity tools.



Design systems that reduce manual intervention while maintaining accuracy, reliability, and appropriate human oversight.



Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve implemented automation systems.



Document workflows, integrations, and technical processes.



4. AI Tools & Custom Solutions Development



Evaluate and implement AI technologies such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other large language models.



Build custom AI assistants, chatbots, internal tools, and AI-powered business applications.



Develop AI workflows for document processing, information retrieval, data analysis, and operational reporting.



Explore AI agents and agentic workflows where they provide practical business value.



Work with APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations to connect business systems.



Collaborate with our IT and development teams when custom development is required.



Ensure AI solutions are secure, reliable, maintainable, and appropriate for business use.



5. Team Training & AI Adoption



Assess how different departments currently use AI and identify opportunities for improvement.



Train employees on effective and responsible use of AI tools.



Develop standard operating procedures, training materials, and best practices for AI-assisted workflows.



Help teams integrate AI into their daily responsibilities.



Promote an AI-driven culture focused on efficiency, innovation, and continuous improvement.



Monitor adoption and provide ongoing support to employees.



6. Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement



Establish measurable KPIs for AI and automation initiatives.



Track improvements in productivity, turnaround times, operating costs, accuracy, and employee efficiency.



Measure the return on investment of implemented AI solutions.



Monitor automated workflows and identify areas for further optimisation.



Provide regular progress reports, recommendations, and performance updates to management.



Ensure AI systems comply with applicable Australian and New Zealand privacy, data security, and healthcare regulations.



Qualifications & Requirements



Proven experience in AI implementation, business process automation, workflow optimisation, or a closely related field.



Strong understanding of business operations, process improvement, and systems integration.



Hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows and automation solutions.



Proficiency with AI tools and platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and related technologies.



Experience using automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Microsoft Power Automate.

Experience developing AI assistants, chatbots, or other AI-powered business tools.



Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.



Ability to translate complex business challenges into practical technical solutions.



Excellent English communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Ability to independently manage projects from initial assessment through implementation.



Experience documenting workflows, developing SOPs, and training teams.



Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working setup.

Background in healthcare, pharmacy, medical clinics, telehealth, or other regulated industries.

What Success Looks Like

Successfully implement AI-powered workflows that reduce manual work.

Freedom to recommend and implement innovative solutions.

- Maintain existing templates while incorporating new information.

2. PUBLISHING & DIGITAL CONTENT DESIGN



Through Next Level Publishing, we help authors bring their books and ideas to life.



You'll also assist with:



- Reviewing and refining book layouts using Reedsy.

- Editing and improving workbooks created in Gamma.

- Designing lead magnets, eBooks, and digital resources.

- Creating professional presentation slides.

- Developing graphics for websites and landing pages.

- Making design adjustments to existing publishing materials.

- Ensuring all finished materials meet our quality standards.



You do not need to be an expert in every publishing tool when you apply, but you must be willing and able to learn new platforms quickly.





3. ADDITIONAL CREATIVE PROJECTS



Occasionally, our clients request special projects, including:



- Promotional videos for church events.

- Special announcement graphics.

- Marketing campaign creatives.

- Website graphics.

- Social media advertisements.

- Other creative assignments.



We'll provide clear instructions, examples, and deadlines for these projects.





TOOLS & SOFTWARE



We're looking for someone experienced with several of the following:



Video Editing



- Adobe Premiere Pro

- CapCut

- Descript

- Other professional video editing software



Graphic Design



- Canva

- Adobe Photoshop

- Other professional design tools



AI & Publishing



- ChatGPT

- Gamma

- Reedsy

- AI-assisted video and design tools



Communication & Project Management



- Slack

- ClickUp

- Google Drive

- Google Workspace



You don't need to know every platform.



What's most important is your willingness to learn, adapt, and use technology to work more efficiently.



We're constantly exploring new AI tools and workflows to make our work easier, faster, and better.



We want someone who's excited about that!





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



CREATIVE EXCELLENCE



You have a strong eye for design, understand visual storytelling, and consistently produce professional-quality work.



STRONG COMMUNICATION



This is extremely important.



We need someone who communicates consistently during scheduled working hours.



You should be comfortable:



- Responding to messages in a timely manner.

- Providing updates on assigned projects.

- Asking questions when instructions aren't clear.

- Communicating delays before deadlines are missed.

- Letting us know when you're unavailable.



We don't expect perfection, but we do expect professionalism, transparency, and accountability.



INDEPENDENCE & ORGANIZATION



We're looking for someone who can receive an assignment, understand the expectations, and complete it without constant supervision.



You'll be responsible for managing multiple client assignments throughout the week.



You must be comfortable using project management software to track deadlines and progress.



A GROWTH MINDSET



Our company is growing, and our processes will continue evolving.



We want someone who's excited about learning new skills, embracing AI technology, and improving how work gets done.



RESPECT FOR FAITH-BASED CONTENT



A significant portion of our work involves churches, pastors, sermons, and Christian organizations.



We would love to find someone who genuinely enjoys creating content that encourages people and shares meaningful messages.



You don't have to be a pastor or ministry professional, but you should be comfortable working with Christian content and understand the importance of handling these messages with care and respect.





COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Starting Salary: $950 USD Per Month



Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week



This is intended to be a long-term position, not a temporary freelance project.



We offer:



- Consistent monthly compensation.

- The opportunity to work remotely from the Philippines.

- A supportive, collaborative working environment.

- Training on new software and AI tools.

- Opportunities to develop additional creative and technical skills.

- Performance-based salary increases as the company grows.

- Opportunities for greater responsibility and professional advancement.



We believe that when someone consistently brings value to our company, their compensation should reflect that growth.





HOW TO APPLY



We're looking for someone who can demonstrate both creativity and professionalism.



To apply, please provide:



1. A BRIEF INTRODUCTION



Tell us about yourself, your experience, and why you're interested in working with our company.



2. YOUR PORTFOLIO



Please share examples of:



- Short-form video editing.

- YouTube thumbnails.

- Social media graphics.

- Any other creative work you're especially proud of.



3. YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH AI



Tell us which AI tools you've used and how you've incorporated them into your creative workflow.



4. YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH FAITH-BASED CONTENT



Have you worked with churches, ministries, Christian organizations, or other faith-based clients?



If not, tell us why this type of work interests you.



5. YOUR AVAILABILITY



Confirm whether you're available to work 40 hours per week and whether you're comfortable maintaining consistent communication during agreed working hours.



6. A SHORT VIDEO INTRODUCTION



Please record a 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you'd be a great fit for this position.



This helps us get to know you beyond your portfolio.





OUR HIRING PROCESS



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a brief interview.



Selected finalists will then complete a paid creative skills assessment involving video editing and graphic design.



We'll evaluate creativity, attention to detail, communication, ability to follow instructions, and turnaround time.



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the most impressive résumé.



We're looking for someone who's talented, dependable, eager to learn, and excited to build something meaningful with us.





A FINAL WORD



At Next Level Media Marketing, we're building more than a marketing agency.



We're building a company that helps churches reach their communities, authors share their stories, and organizations communicate messages that make a difference.



We're praying to find the right person who can become an important part of that mission.



If you're looking for a long-term opportunity where your creativity is valued, your work has meaning, and you have room to grow, we'd love to hear from you.



We look forward to meeting you!



Next Level Media Marketing & Next Level Publishing

title: Buildium Coordinator
description:

We are a U.S. real estate owner/operator seeking an experienced, organized professional to support our multifamily property management and construction operations.

Buildium & Lease Administration

s, and messages professionally.

Your resume.

title: Estimating Assistant
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME AND A VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Estimating Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday - Friday, 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour unpaid break.



Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Estimating Assistant to support Advanced Framing Structures (AFS), a Southern California commercial rough-carpentry and wood-framing subcontractor. In this role, you will process bid invitations, download and organize project documents, maintain accurate bid records in HubSpot, and prepare plan files and overlays in PlanSwift. You will work closely with the estimating team to ensure bid opportunities, deadlines, and project documents are complete, organized, and ready for review. 



The ideal candidate has strong administrative processing skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. Construction experience is helpful but not required. This is an administrative support role, not an independent estimating, pricing, or decision-making position.



Key Responsibilities:

Bid Invitation Administration

* Monitor assigned estimating
 inboxes, bid portals, and other sources for new Invitations to Bid (ITBs).

* Download bid invitations and related project documents, including plans, specifications, addenda, bid instructions, and available project information.

* Enter or update bid opportunity information in HubSpot and other company tracking systems.

* Record bid due dates, project names, General Contractor information, locations, and other required opportunity details.

* Respond to bid invitations using approved company responses and direction from the estimating team.

* Record whether AFS intends to bid, decline, or requires estimator review before responding.

* Flag duplicate invitations, missing documents, unclear due dates, addenda, or other issues for estimator review.



Bid Document Organization

* Create and maintain organized electronic bid folders using AFS naming and filing standards.

* Save plans, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and other documents in the correct project folder.

* Maintain current versions of documents and clearly identify revised or superseded plan sets when directed.

* Notify the assigned estimator when new plans, addenda, or material bid documents are received.

* Help maintain an accurate and easy-to-follow electronic record for each bid opportunity.



PlanSwift Support

* Upload/import project plan sets into PlanSwift.

* Organize and label plan pages so estimators can locate drawings efficiently.

* Verify basic page orientation and plan-file completeness before handing the file to the estimator.

* Set up plan overlays to compare revised drawings against prior plan versions using the company's established process.

* Identify and flag apparent drawing changes shown by overlays for estimator review.

* Do not independently determine the estimating, scope, cost, or schedule impact of drawing changes.



HubSpot / CRM Administration

* Create and update bid opportunities, companies, contacts, due dates, stages, and activity information in HubSpot.

* Maintain clean and consistent CRM records and avoid duplicate companies, contacts, or opportunities.

* Update opportunity status based on direction from the estimating team.

* Assist with routine CRM data cleanup, record maintenance, and reporting support as assigned.

* HubSpot experience is preferred but not required, as training may be provided to candidates with strong administrative skills.



Estimating Team Support

* Maintain bid calendars, trackers, and administrative task lists as assigned.

* Assist estimators with locating, downloading, renaming, organizing, and distributing bid documents.

* Perform routine data entry and document-preparation tasks related to estimating.

* Follow up internally when information or direction is needed to complete an assigned administrative task.

* Support other routine estimating administrative work consistent with the level and purpose of the position.



Required Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, data entry, document control, CRM administration, accounts payable, construction administration, estimating support, or a similar role is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling repetitive tasks and high volumes of administrative information.

* Excellent digital file management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.

* Experience downloading, uploading, renaming, organizing, and managing digital documents, especially large PDF files.

* Good written English and the ability to prepare concise, professional
s and communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to follow written instructions, established procedures, checklists, and naming conventions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying missing information, conflicting dates, duplicate records, revised documents, and other discrepancies.

* Ability to verify information, check work for errors, and use organized systems to maintain accuracy rather than relying solely on memory.

* Willingness to ask questions and escalate unclear instructions rather than guess or make unsupported assumptions.

* Ability to learn new software and workflows quickly and demonstrate tasks through screen sharing when required.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven administrative work.

* Ability to work independently within clearly defined responsibilities and maintain reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule aligned with AFS's Southern California operations.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with PlanSwift; familiarity with Bluebeam or similar PDF and plan-document software is an advantage.

* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

* Previous experience in construction administration, estimating support, bid coordination, or document control.

* Familiarity with construction plans, specifications, bid invitations, addenda, and general construction terminology.

* Experience using trackers, checklists, and standardized filing systems to maintain accurate records and prevent errors.

* Note: PlanSwift and HubSpot experience is preferred but not required.



Working Conditions

* This position focuses on administrative processing, document management, CRM maintenance, and plan preparation to support the estimating team.

* The employee will not make independent bid/no-bid decisions or determine which project scope should be included or excluded.

* Establishing labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, markup, or final bid pricing is outside the scope of this role.

* Independent final quantity takeoffs, estimating approvals, pricing negotiations, and contract decisions are not part of the position.

* The employee must not submit final proposals or make commitments on behalf of AFS without authorization.

* Plan overlays are prepared to help identify drawing revisions. Determining their scope, cost, or scheduling impact is the responsibility of the estimator.

* Missing documents, conflicting information, unclear instructions, and unusual requests must be escalated to the assigned estimator or estimating leader.

* The employee is expected to maintain organized records, follow established procedures, and communicate progress or issues promptly to the estimating team.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator
description:
***** TO BE CONSIDERED AS AN APPLICANT, PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR MOST UP-TO-DATE RESUME ANDA VIDEO INTRODUCTION TAILORED TO THIS JOB POSTING***** 



Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator 



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: TBD



Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced Remote Rough Carpentry Estimator to support our U.S.-based estimating team. This role is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing detailed quantity takeoffs, identifying scope requirements, and preparing accurate rough carpentry estimates for commercial, multifamily, educational, prevailing wage, and other construction projects.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wood framing construction and can independently interpret architectural and structural plans, specifications, details, sections, schedules, and general notes. Accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and clear communication are essential, particularly when identifying missing, conflicting, or unclear information.



Key Responsibilities:

Plan & Specification Review

* Review architectural, structural, and applicable civil plans.

* Review project specifications and identify requirements affecting the rough carpentry scope.

* Interpret plans, details, sections, schedules, and general notes.

* Identify discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

* Identify missing information and items requiring clarification or RFI.

* Review addenda, bulletins, RFIs, and revised drawings and determine their impact on the estimate.



Quantity Takeoffs

* Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs for rough carpentry materials and labor, including:

* Dimensional lumber, wall framing, wood stud walls, and interior/exterior framing

* Floor and roof framing, roof/floor/wall sheathing, plywood, and OSB

* Blocking and backing, miscellaneous wood framing, pressure-treated lumber, sill plates, and ledgers

* Posts and beams, glulam beams, LVL, and engineered wood products

* Hardware and connectors, including hold-downs, straps, clips, hangers, anchor bolts, and fastening requirements

* Trusses, roof/floor truss-related scope, and miscellaneous rough carpentry materials

* Clearly identify quantities by building, floor, area, and material type whenever applicable.



Labor Estimating

* Assist with developing labor quantities based on takeoff information.

* Understand the relationship between material quantities and field installation.

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

* Identify prevailing wage or other labor requirements shown in the bid documents.



Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Review scope responsibilities and general contractor requirements.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Organize takeoffs in accordance with company estimating standards.

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams

* Experience with construction estimating software and PDF plan/specification management systems is a plus

* Willingness to ask questions and seek clarification rather than make unsupported assumptions

* Able to work during agreed-upon overlapping hours with the U.S.-based team



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

Accountability & Ownership

Listing updates with ad strategy

Inventory levels with promo and demand forecasts

Creative needs with conversion goals

Manage reporting and ensure action items are executed consistently



Long-Term Projects & Goals

Create a repeatable system for ongoing listing improvement and CRO

Improve customer loyalty and retention through stronger messaging, brand voice, and content

Develop SOPs for listing updates, creative briefs, review management, and performance reporting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI 1: Listing Quality & Organic Performance

Objective: Improve listing visibility and discoverability through optimization



Metrics:

Keyword indexing coverage + organic rank improvements

CTR improvements (Search + ads-supported)

Monitor indexing, rank trends, and category attribute completeness

Objective: Improve brand reputation and customer experience

Metrics:

Review rating + review velocity

Return rate trends and top return reasons

title: Experienced Xero Bookkeeper & VA BILLING SPECIALIST
description:
Experienced Xero Bookkeeper & VA Billing Specialist



Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



About Genesis Homecare Agency



Genesis Homecare Agency is a growing U.S.-based non-medical homecare company serving veterans, seniors, and individuals who need assistance with daily living.



We are seeking a highly organized, experienced, and proactive Xero Bookkeeper & VA Billing Specialist to manage our financial records, monitor cash flow, reconcile payroll, and help transition our VA Community Care billing from an outsourced provider to an internal process.



We are not looking for someone who simply enters transactions. We need a dependable professional who can identify discrepancies, monitor financial performance, follow up on unpaid claims, and provide accurate financial information to support management decisions.



Key Responsibilities



Xero Bookkeeping & Financial Management



* Maintain accurate financial records in Xero.

* Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial transactions.

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Categorize expenses and maintain an organized chart of accounts.

* Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements.

* Develop and maintain a rolling 13-week cash-flow forecast.

* Provide weekly financial summaries, including available cash, upcoming payroll, outstanding invoices, and upcoming expenses.

* Identify unnecessary expenses, discrepancies, and opportunities to improve profitability.

* Maintain accurate records for CPA review and tax preparation.

* Assist with bookkeeping for multiple business entities as needed.



VA Community Care Billing & Claims Management



* Assist with transitioning VA Community Care billing from our current outsourced billing provider to an internal process.

* Review service authorizations, scheduled visits, completed caregiver documentation, and electronic visit verification (EVV) records.

* Verify that billed services match authorized and completed care.

* Prepare and submit VA Community Care claims through approved billing systems, subject to required training and authorization.

* Monitor claim status, reimbursement activity, rejected claims, and denials.

* Investigate billing discrepancies and correct or resubmit eligible claims.

* Track outstanding VA receivables and follow up on unpaid claims.

* Reconcile VA payments and remittance records against submitted claims.

* Maintain organized billing records and communicate claim issues to management.

* Coordinate with our operations team to resolve missing documentation and authorization discrepancies.

* Follow applicable HIPAA, VA, payer, and company security requirements.



Payroll Reconciliation



* Reconcile payroll transactions from Paylocity with Xero.

* Track employee wages, employer payroll taxes, deductions, and payroll liabilities.

* Identify payroll discrepancies and ensure accurate accounting entries.

* Monitor upcoming payroll obligations to support adequate cash reserves.



Accounts Receivable & Payer Tracking



* Monitor collections from VA Community Care, insurance-related payers, private-pay clients, and other referral partners.

* Track outstanding invoices, payment discrepancies, and overdue balances.

* Maintain payer-specific revenue and profitability reports.

* Provide weekly updates on collections and outstanding receivables.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 3 years of professional bookkeeping experience.

* Strong hands-on experience using Xero.

* Experience working with U.S.-based businesses and U.S. accounting practices.

* Experience reconciling payroll, employer taxes, and payroll liabilities.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliation.

* Ability to prepare accurate financial statements and cash-flow forecasts.

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent written English communication and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and proactively report discrepancies.

* Willingness to learn healthcare billing workflows and follow strict confidentiality requirements.



Strongly Preferred



* Direct experience with U.S. healthcare billing or revenue cycle management.

* Experience submitting CMS-1500 or 837P professional claims.

* Familiarity with VA Community Care billing, claims administrators, and clearinghouses.

* Experience with claim denials, remittance advice, and payment posting.

* Experience using AxisCare or similar homecare management software.

* Experience with Paylocity or similar U.S. payroll platforms.

* Xero certification.

* Experience supporting multiple business entities.



What Success Looks Like



* Accurate, up-to-date Xero bookkeeping.

* Bank and credit card accounts reconciled consistently.

* Payroll liabilities correctly recorded and monitored.

* A reliable weekly cash-flow forecast.

* Clear visibility into outstanding VA and other payer receivables.

* Timely, accurate claims submission after an approved billing transition.

* Reduced billing discrepancies, preventable denials, and unnecessary expenses.

* Monthly financial reports delivered on schedule without repeated follow-up.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your resume and a brief description of your Xero experience.

2. Your experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

3. Whether you have directly submitted U.S. healthcare claims, including VA Community Care claims.

4. Your experience with CMS-1500/837P claims, clearinghouses, payment posting, and denial management.

5. Your experience reconciling U.S. payroll and employer tax liabilities.

6. Examples of financial reports or cash-flow forecasts you have prepared, with confidential information removed.

7. Your desired hourly rate in USD.

8. Your availability and preferred working hours.



Subject Line: XERO & VA BILLING SPECIALIST



We are looking for a long-term team member who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates proactively, and helps our company maintain strong financial operations.



Genesis Homecare Agency LLC

title: Outbound Sales Representative — Cold & Warm Calling  (Remote, Full-Time/Part-Time)
description:
Company: Harvest Panel Systems (Harvest Panels) — Oklahoma, USA Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, US Central Time business hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT)  - Pay $8 base + commission/bonus



About Us

Harvest Panel Systems distributes insulated metal panels (IMPs), cooler doors and trim from Oklahoma to customers across the US. We serve contractors, builders and owners of cold storage facilities, walk-in coolers and freezers, cultivation and grow rooms, food processing plants, cleanrooms and metal buildings. Our panels are in stock and ship nationwide.



The Role

You will be the voice of Harvest Panels on the phone. You will make outbound cold calls, call warm leads from our
 campaigns and website, and follow up on quotes until they close. You will work hand-in-hand with our
 campaign specialist so every lead gets the right call at the right time. Because you will speak directly with American contractors and business owners, perfect spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent is essential.



Responsibilities

• Make 60–100+ outbound calls per day to contractors, builders and facility owners

• Call warm leads who opened, clicked or replied to our
 campaigns, and inbound web inquiries

• Follow up on sent quotes, estimates and past conversations

• Qualify leads: project type, size (square footage), timeline, location and decision-maker

• Book calls and estimate requests for our sales team; collect floor plans and project details

• Log every call, outcome, note and next step in Pipedrive (our CRM) the same day

• Coordinate with the
 specialist on timing, talk tracks and lead priorities

• Leave clear, professional voi
s and send short follow-up
s after calls

• Report daily call numbers and weekly results (connects, conversations, appointments, quotes)



Requirements

• Native-level spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent — this is the #1 requirement

• 2+ years of outbound sales or cold-calling experience for US clients (B2B strongly preferred)

• Confident, friendly and persistent; comfortable handling objections and rejection

• CRM experience; Pipedrive preferred (HubSpot or Salesforce also considered)

• Able to learn technical product details (panel thickness, R-values, door types) and explain them simply

• High-quality USB headset with noise cancelling, quiet workspace, reliable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power/internet

• Available to work US Central Time business hours



Nice to Have

• Experience selling construction, building materials, HVAC/refrigeration or industrial products

• Experience with dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, JustCall, Kixie or similar)



How to Apply

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume

2. Links to your website, portfolio or LinkedIn (if applicable)

3. A short list of past work and projects you have handled (company or industry, your role, and results if available)

4. A voice recording (MP3 or a Vocaroo/Google Drive link) of you reading the script below in a natural, conversational sales tone. Do not use any audio editing or filters. Record in one take, 1–2 minutes

5. Your expected monthly rate in USD and your available start date



Voice Recording Script (for Job Ad 2 applicants)

Applicants read this aloud as if on a live cold call. It runs about 90 seconds and includes product terms, numbers, US place names and an objection, so you can judge accent, pronunciation, pacing and tone.

Instructions for applicants: Read the script below as if you are speaking to a real contractor on the phone. Sound natural and friendly, not robotic. Words in [brackets] are for you to fill in (use your own first name).



Opening

"Hi, is this Mike? Great. Mike, this is [Your Name] with Harvest Panel Systems out of Oklahoma. I know I'm catching you out of the blue, so I'll be quick. Do you have about thirty seconds?"



Reason for the call

"Thanks. We supply insulated metal panels, cooler doors and trim to contractors building cold storage, walk-in coolers and freezers, grow rooms and food processing facilities. I'm calling because a lot of builders we talk to are dealing with long lead times and rising material costs, and we've been able to help with both."



Value

"Our panels combine the wall, the insulation, the vapor barrier and the finish in one product, so crews can install them much faster than traditional framing. Our four-inch panel is rated R-thirty, and we keep stock lengths of ten, twelve, fourteen, sixteen and twenty feet ready to ship from our warehouse in Piedmont, Oklahoma. Stock orders can usually reach you anywhere in the continental U.S. within forty-eight hours after they leave our facility."



Handling an objection

"Totally understand you already have a supplier. Most of our customers did too. We're not asking you to switch today. We just offer a best price guarantee, so if you send us a competitor's written quote, we'll take a look and match it. That way you've got a reliable backup when your usual supplier is backordered."



Close

"Do you have any projects coming up in the next three to six months? If you can send over a floor plan, our team will put together a free estimate and design layout for you. What's the best
 to send that to? Perfect. I'll send it over today and give you a follow-up call on Thursday. Thanks for your time, Mike, and have a great afternoon."

title: Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager runs the operational backbone of the business and acts as the Management Representative for our Integrated Management System. You will keep day-to-day operations running smoothly and compliantly — procurement, supplier, asset and access management, business continuity, document control and cross-department coordination across our UK and Philippines teams — while owning the QMS, ISMS and AIMS: maintaining them, keeping them audit-ready, running internal audits and management reviews, and driving continual improvement. You will also run the quarterly project cadence that keeps every department's projects on track. It is a hands-on governance and operations leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director, with scope to build an Operations Assistant function and automate recurring work.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Integrated Management System & governance (Management Representative)

• Establish, maintain and continually improve the IMS across ISO 9001, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, and report its performance to top management.

• Own the internal audit programme end-to-end — plan, schedule, conduct or coordinate audits, log findings and drive them to closure; act as primary liaison with BSI and external/certification auditors.

• Organise and facilitate management reviews; capture minutes, decisions and actions.

• Run document control: the controlled-document register, version control, scheduled reviews and approvals.

• Coordinate nonconformity and corrective/preventive action (NC/CAPA) across all three systems, tracking each to closure.

• Own the integrated risk & opportunity process: maintain the register, facilitate assessments,

drive treatments and recommend residual-risk acceptance to the Managing Director.

• Steward the scope, Statement of Applicability, policies and objectives, keeping them current.



Project & portfolio governance

• Run the quarterly project cadence across the business — review each department's projects to ensure they are running as planned, on scope and on schedule.

• Maintain the project tracker; surface slippage, risks, blockers and dependencies, and hold owners to their commitments.

• Report project status and portfolio health to the Managing Director, and keep BAU (run) work and project (change) work clearly separated.



Compliance, information security & risk

• Administer information-security operations: asset inventory, access identities and periodic user-access reviews, supplier/third-party security management, BYOD compliance, i
 logging and coordination, and change management.

• Maintain the legal, regulatory and contractual requirements register and coordinate operational compliance (UK GDPR/data protection, sector and AI-governance obligations).

• Own business-continuity and disaster-recovery readiness — plans, drills and tests.



Operations & resource management

• Run the procurement and purchasing process, including supplier onboarding and due diligence.

• Coordinate cross-department alignment – weekly scoreboards and accountability, townhall inputs and BAU governance.

• Manage company tooling and the asset lifecycle; support operational budgeting.



People & culture (in partnership with HR)

• Support HR on onboarding/offboarding, the recruitment pipeline, the training & competence framework, the PDP cycle and rota/payroll oversight (HR owns execution).

• Champion an accountability culture across the UK and Philippines teams, and maintain the competence & awareness (training) matrix.



Performance, reporting & continual improvement

• Own monitoring and measurement – KPIs, scoreboards and performance evaluation – and report to leadership.

• Drive continual improvement and manage organisational change.



Leadership, delegation & automation

• Line-manage the operations and people-support functions; delegate effectively, and build and develop an Operations Assistant role.

• Use work-management tooling (
) and AI-enabled automation to streamline recurring governance and BAU work.





QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & TRACK RECORD

We are hiring for experience. What you have actually run matters far more to us than the certificates you hold — a strong operator who has genuinely owned a live management system will always beat a certificate on its own. You should be able to point to concrete examples for most of the below.

• 5+ years in operations, quality or business-management roles, including at least 2 years managing people or running a function.

• Hands-on experience owning or running a live, ISO-certified management system in day-to-day operation — ISO 9001 and/or ISO 27001 (ISO 42001 a plus). This means having actually maintained it — document control, internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions and risk — not simply holding a certificate.

• Direct experience of external certification audits — preparing for and being audited by a certification body (e.g. BSI or similar) and taking findings and nonconformities through to closure.

• Proven experience running internal audits (ISO 19011 principles) and managing NC/CAPA and a risk & opportunity register.

• Experience running a regular project review or cadence and keeping delivery on track across multiple teams or departments.

• Practical experience of information-security governance operations — access reviews, asset management, supplier/third-party risk, i
 handling and business continuity.

• Experience of document control / management-system administration.

• Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams (e.g. UK and Philippines) and working across time zones.

• Hands-on with 
 or a comparable work-management platform, and comfortable using automation or AI to reduce manual work.

• Experience line-managing, delegating and building out a team or an assistant function.

• Sound data-protection / UK GDPR awareness and the discretion to handle confidential security, HR and commercial information.

• Excellent English communication and stakeholder management at all levels, including with senior leadership and external auditors.

• Highly organised and self-directed — able to manage many concurrent recurring obligations to deadline with minimal supervision.

We prioritise proven experience over formal qualifications. A relevant degree (business, operations, quality or information management) is welcome but not essential, and ISO / audit certifications are a nice-to-have rather than a prerequisite — we will happily consider candidates whose hands-on track record demonstrates the same capability.



DESIRABLE/NICE TO HAVE (not required)

None of the below is essential — they are advantages. Where a certification is listed, equivalent hands-on experience is valued just as highly.

• ISO 27001 and/or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification – a bonus, not a prerequisite.

• A project-management qualification or method (e.g. PRINCE2, Agile) or a comparable delivery track record.

• ISO 42001/AI-governance exposure.

• Cyber Essentials familiarity; a data-protection qualification (e.g. GDPR Practitioner, CIPP/E).

• Procurement/vendor-management experience.

• Continual-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma) or change-management exposure.

• Experience in a SaaS or technology business.
