title: Experienced Real Estate Acquisitions & Dispositions Specialist (Wholesaling)
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Schedule: 25–30 hours per week initially, with potential for full-time work

Working Hours: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Compensation: $8–$12 per hour, based on experience — PLUS high-paying commission on closed deals. Top performers earn significantly more than the hourly rate alone.



About the Position



We are a growing U.S.-based real estate wholesaling company looking for an experienced Acquisitions & Dispositions Specialist to help manage our daily operations.



Our company uses X-Leads CRM and AI-powered marketing to identify motivated sellers. Once a property owner expresses interest, you will take over seller qualification, property research, CRM management, and follow-up.



You will also help build and manage our cash-buyer database, research active real estate investors, and support the disposition and closing process.



This is not an entry-level position. We are looking for someone who already understands U.S. real estate wholesaling and can work independently.



Key Responsibilities



Seller Acquisitions



- Monitor new interested seller leads in X-Leads.

- Review AI-generated seller conversations.

- Contact and qualify motivated sellers.

- Gather property condition, asking price, motivation, and selling timeline.

- Research comparable sales and preliminary after-repair values (ARV).

- Maintain accurate CRM records and follow-up schedules.

- Submit qualified opportunities to management for review.



Buyer Dispositions



- Research and identify active cash buyers and investors.

- Build and maintain an organized buyer database.

- Qualify investors based on buying criteria, budget, location, and investment strategy.

- Match potential buyers with company-approved opportunities.

- Coordinate authorized buyer inquiries and administrative follow-ups.

- Assist with transaction tracking and closing coordination.



CRM & Operations



- Manage seller and buyer pipelines in X-Leads.

- Keep detailed notes on all conversations.

- Schedule and complete follow-up tasks.

- Track transaction deadlines.

- Prepare daily activity and performance reports.

- Escalate important opportunities and issues to management.



Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of experience in U.S. real estate wholesaling.

- Experience with both acquisitions and dispositions.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong motivated-seller qualification skills.

- Experience locating and qualifying cash buyers.

- Understanding of comps, ARV, repair estimates, and wholesale transactions.

- Experience with real estate CRM software.

- Strong organization, communication, and follow-up skills.

- Reliable internet, computer, headset, and quiet workspace.



Preferred Experience: X-Leads, REsimpli, Podio, PropStream, or similar platforms.



Important: Decision-Making Authority



The specialist is responsible for research, qualification, follow-up, and administrative coordination.



All purchase offers, pricing decisions, negotiations, contracts, and final transaction approvals are handled exclusively by company management.



How to Apply



To confirm you read this full post, start your application message with the word "NexDoor".



Please submit:



1. Your résumé and relevant wholesaling experience.

4. A description of a wholesale transaction you helped manage.

5. Your experience qualifying motivated sellers and cash buyers.

Qualified candidates will be invited to an interview and paid practical assessment.



We are looking for a long-term team member who can help us build an organized, efficient, and growing wholesaling operation. Your effort directly increases your pay: every deal you help close pays you commission on top of your hourly rate.

, LinkedIn and professional networks. Your responsibility extends from making the first contact and arranging qualified meetings to advancing opportunities through proposals, negotiations and paid engagements.



This role requires a confident English communicator who combines commercial judgment with consistent execution and can work independently.



Key Responsibilities

- Prospecting and outreach: Research target organizations, identify decision-makers and conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls,
, LinkedIn and other relevant channels. Build relationships with prospective clients and generate qualified business opportunities.

- Customer discovery and qualification: Lead conversations to understand business needs, assess fit with our services and establish budget, decision-making authority and purchasing timelines. Coordinate meetings with the founder where subject-matter expertise is needed.

- Market research and offer development: Research customer needs, competitors and purchasing behavior. Use buyer feedback to recommend priority customer segments, refine service offerings and propose pricing that considers customer value, delivery costs and margins.

- Commercial validation: Test offers through proposals, paid pilots and initial engagements. Evaluate demand using evidence such as deposits, paid bookings and purchases, and recommend which opportunities to pursue, refine or discontinue.

- Proposals and commercial follow-through: Prepare clear proposals, maintain timely follow-up, address objections and negotiate within agreed parameters. Move qualified opportunities toward signed agreements and payment.

- Partnership development: Build relationships with employers, training providers, professional associations and other relevant organizations. Develop opportunities for referrals, sponsored programs, paid engagements and joint delivery.

- Pipeline management and reporting: Maintain accurate prospect and partnership records in a CRM or opportunity tracker. Track next steps, buyer feedback, proposals and revenue, and flag obstacles or decisions that require the founder’s input.

Experience and Skills

- Demonstrated success winning clients or commercially valuable partnerships in consulting, training, professional development, technology or comparable services.

- Strong spoken and written English, with the confidence to engage business owners, executives and other decision-makers.

- Hands-on experience with cold calling,
 outreach, prospect qualification and discovery conversations.

- Ability to develop persuasive proposals, communicate the value of services and handle objections and negotiations.

- Experience developing or refining an offer, identifying its target buyer and recommending pricing based on customer evidence and commercial considerations.

- Strong research, organization and follow-through, including disciplined use of a CRM or opportunity tracker.

- Ability to prioritize work, take initiative and bring practical recommendations without daily direction.

- Experience engaging U.S. or international buyers is an advantage.

What Success Looks Like



You will build a qualified pipeline, advance opportunities into paid engagements and establish partnerships that contribute to business growth. You will also help Stratera Global understand which offers buyers will pay for and develop a repeatable outreach and follow-up process.



The founder will provide subject-matter expertise, confirm delivery capability and approve final pricing and contractual commitments.

title: DISPATCHER FOR US PLUMBING & CLEANING COMPANY
description:
We are a plumbing and cleaning company serving customers in Florida and Texas, United States. We are hiring one dispatcher to answer inbound calls, book jobs on the schedule, and keep our technicians and cleaning crews moving.



This is a phone role. You are the first voice a customer hears when their water heater is leaking or they need a cleaning crew fast. They are already stressed when they call. If you are not confident holding a full conversation in English on the phone, please do not apply.



SCHEDULE

56 hours per week, 7 days per week. Shifts are set weekly in Central and Eastern Time, and I will send you the Philippine time conversion with each schedule. This is a night shift in the Philippines and the hours can change from week to week. Please be sure you can hold this schedule long term before you apply.



SALARY

$500 USD per month plus bonuses, paid weekly. Bonus details are shared during the interview. Payment platform to be discussed with the selected candidate.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Answer every inbound call within three rings

Qualify the caller: full name, service address, callback number, what the problem is, how urgent it is

Book the job on the calendar and confirm it with the technician or cleaning crew

Send confirmation and reminder text messages

Follow up the same day on every call that did not book

Log every call in our custom CRM. Every one, with notes.

Send payment links and follow up on unpaid invoices

Reschedule and re-dispatch when a technician or crew runs long on a job

Take on other tasks as the business grows, such as admin work, customer follow-ups, and help with our online listings and reviews. You will be trained on anything new.



REQUIREMENTS



Previous dispatching experience for a US home service company. Plumbing, cleaning, HVAC, electrical, roofing, or garage door. Please name the companies.

Hands-on CRM experience. Tell me which CRMs you used and what you did inside them. You will be trained on our custom CRM.

Clear spoken English with a neutral accent. You will be on the phone all day.

At least 15 Mbps internet with a backup connection, plus backup power for brownouts

Noise-cancelling headset and a quiet room. No background noise on calls.

Able to stay calm with an angry customer



NICE TO HAVE



Experience taking card payments over the phone

Google Calendar based dispatching

Basic plumbing and cleaning vocabulary so you can describe the problem to the technician accurately



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any of these four steps will not be opened.



Put the word DISPATCH at the top of your application. It tells me you read the whole post.

Go to 
. It is free and needs no account. Record yourself reading the script below out loud, the way you would actually say it on a call. Copy the link and paste it into your application.

In your message, list:

Which US home service companies you dispatched for, and for how long

Which CRMs you have used

Your internet speed test result

Confirmation that you can work a 7-day schedule with shifts set weekly in Central and Eastern Time (night shift in the Philippines)

Answer this in one or two sentences: a customer calls at 4:30pm saying they have no hot water and every technician is already booked for the day. What do you say to them?



SCRIPT TO RECORD ON VOCAROO

“Thank you for calling Gulf Standard Cleaning, this is [your name], how can I help you today? Okay, I am sorry that is happening. I can get a technician out to you. Can I get your full service address and the best number to reach you? Perfect. We have an opening today between two and four. Does that window work for you? You are all set. You will get a text confirmation in the next few minutes, and the technician will call before he heads your way. Thank you for calling Gulf Standard Cleaning.”

title: Canadian Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online Specialist)
description:
We are a growing Canadian bookkeeping firm looking for a meticulous, detail-oriented remote bookkeeper to handle basic transactional bookkeeping across multiple client files. This is a steady, monthly part-time role. You will work directly inside our QuickBooks Online Accountant portal to keep our clients' books accurate, organized, and up to date. 



Key Responsibilities 

-Multi-File Management: Efficiently switch between multiple small-to-medium Canadian client files while maintaining strict accuracy. 

-Daily Transaction Mapping: Categorize bank and credit card transactions correctly inside QuickBooks Online. 

-Bank Reconciliations: Perform monthly bank, credit card, and loan reconciliations to ensure zero discrepancies. 

-Sales Tax Compliance: Accurately track and map GST, HST, and PST based on the client’s specific province, ensuring Input Tax Credits (ITCs) are claimed correctly. 

-Receipt Matching: Match receipts and invoices using source documents via tools like Dext or QuickBooks receipts. 

-Discrepancy Flagging: Maintain a clean paper trail and flag uncategorized expenses or missing receipts for senior review. 



Required Qualifications 

-Canadian Bookkeeping Experience: Minimum 2+ years of direct experience bookkeeping for Canadian businesses or Canadian accounting firms. 

-Software Mastery: Must be a certified QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor (you will be asked to provide your certification link). 

-Tax Knowledge: Solid understanding of CRA guidelines, provincial sales tax rules (e.g., ON vs. AB vs. BC), and how ITCs work. 

-Tech Setup: A reliable, high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps) with a backup power/internet solution in place. 

-Communication: Excellent written English skills for internal communication and team updates.

title: Moving Sales Representative — Inbound Leads & Closing
description:
Rocket Science Moving Is Hiring: Sales Professional

Fully Remote | Full-Time | Pacific Time

Rocket Science Moving is looking for a determined, professional Sales Representative with 1–3 years of sales experience, strong follow-through, and a “let’s make it work” attitude.

If you stay engaged with customers, take initiative, and care about delivering a great experience, we want to hear from you.

About Us

At Rocket Science Moving, we help customers plan their moves through clear communication, attentive service, and guidance throughout the booking process. We’re building a team that takes ownership, supports one another, and makes every customer feel informed and taken care of.

We do not do cold outreach. No cold calling or prospecting lists. You’ll work with hot leads—customers who have already expressed interest in moving services.

What You’ll Do

    •    Respond quickly to new inquiries and guide interested customers toward booking.

    •    Understand customers’ moving needs and clearly explain services, pricing, and next steps.

    •    Follow up consistently by phone, text, and
.

    •    Handle questions and concerns with patience, confidence, and professionalism.

    •    Keep accurate customer notes, follow-up tasks, and sales activity in our CRM.

    •    Take ownership of your pipeline and results.

    •    Coordinate with teammates to support a smooth customer experience.

Who We’re Looking For

    •    1–3 years of sales experience is required.

    •    Moving industry experience is welcome, but not required.

    •    Strong communication, listening, and relationship-building skills.

    •    Determined individuals who stay active, organized, and accountable.

    •    Consistent follow-through without needing constant reminders or supervision.

    •    A willingness to accept feedback, improve, and put training into practice.

    •    People who lead through action and go above and beyond for customers and teammates.

    •    Persistence paired with respectful, customer-focused communication.

Performance Expectations

Following completion of training and a two-month ramp-up period, you will be expected to maintain:

    •    A minimum booking percentage of 25% of assigned leads.

    •    Speed to lead of less than one minute—making your first contact attempt within 60 seconds of receiving a new lead during your shift.

Fast responses, consistent follow-ups, and accurate CRM records are essential to success in this role. We provide training and coaching to help you meet these standards.

Schedule

Full-time, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT), with possible weekend shifts. You must be available and ready to work during scheduled hours.

Compensation & Payments

The guaranteed base is $300–$700 under a draw-based compensation structure. Your applicable base, compensation period, commission rates, and full terms will be discussed during the interview.

Your base is always guaranteed. If your earned commission exceeds the base for the applicable period, you receive the higher commission amount. Otherwise, you receive your guaranteed base.

Payments are made twice a month by direct deposit to your bank account. Applicants must be able to receive transfers through our supported banking channels. Due to cross-border banking and payment limitations, we currently cannot transfer funds to bank accounts in Russia. We do not pay in cryptocurrency.

What We Provide

    •    Comprehensive training on the moving industry, our services, and our sales process.

    •    A consistent supply of quality, hot leads—no cold outreach required.

    •    All necessary online sales tools, including call routing, inbound calling systems, and a CRM.

    •    Accessible management support and ongoing coaching.

    •    Regular communication and a team-first environment.

    •    Clear expectations and support as you develop your skills.

Remote Workspace Requirements

This is a fully remote role. You must have:

    •    A fast, reliable internet connection.

    •    A dependable laptop or desktop computer that runs our tools smoothly.

    •    A working webcam and a quality headset with a clear microphone.

    •    A quiet, private room where you can speak freely at a normal, confident volume without interruptions.

    •    A tested, reliable setup that supports uninterrupted customer calls and video meetings.

How to Apply

 your résumé and a brief introduction to 
 with the subject line “Sales Professional Application.”

Include your sales experience, availability during Pacific Time hours, and a short example of how your follow-up helped turn an inquiry into a sale.

Bring determination, initiative, and follow-through. We’ll provide the leads, training, tools, and support.

title: Litigation Legal Assistant – U.S. Law Firm
description:
About Triten Law



Triten Law is a U.S.-based law firm seeking an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented Litigation Legal Assistant to support our legal team with litigation matters, case management, legal documentation, and day-to-day legal operations.



We are looking for someone with strong litigation experience who can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and provide reliable support to our attorneys.



This position is initially remote but may transition to an office-based arrangement in Metro Manila in the future.



Key Responsibilities



Litigation Support

- Prepare, format, proofread, and organize legal documents, pleadings, motions, and correspondence.

- Assist with discovery preparation, document requests, and litigation-related filings.

- Maintain accurate and organized electronic case files.

- Track litigation deadlines, court dates, hearings, and case milestones.

- Assist with electronic court filings and document management.

- Support attorneys throughout various stages of litigation.



Case Management

- Maintain and update case information in the firm's case management system.

- Monitor case progress and follow up on outstanding documents, tasks, and deadlines.

- Coordinate with attorneys, clients, and other relevant parties regarding case-related activities.

- Ensure case records are complete, accurate, and accessible to the legal team.



Administrative Support

- Manage legal correspondence, scheduling, and document organization.

- Assist attorneys with calendar management and meeting preparation.

- Communicate professionally with clients, court personnel, and external parties as needed.

- Collaborate with the legal and operations teams to maintain efficient workflows.

- Handle sensitive and confidential client information with professionalism and discretion.



Required Qualifications

- Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Litigation Legal Assistant, Legal Assistant, Litigation Paralegal, or in a comparable litigation support role.

- Demonstrated experience supporting attorneys throughout the litigation process.

- Strong understanding of litigation procedures, legal documentation, and case management workflows.

- Experience using legal case management software.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities.

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a legal team.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and electronic document management.

- Availability to work during required U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Filevine, including case management, document organization, task tracking, and workflow management.

- Experience with comparable legal case management platforms such as Needles, Clio, or similar systems.

- Previous experience supporting U.S.-based litigation attorneys or law firms.

- Familiarity with mass tort or personal injury litigation.

- Experience with electronic court filing systems, discovery, and litigation deadline management.



Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who is:

- Proactive, dependable, and highly organized.

- Comfortable managing multiple litigation matters simultaneously.

- Detail-oriented and capable of handling confidential information.

- Resourceful and able to anticipate the needs of attorneys.

- Adaptable to changing priorities in a fast-paced legal environment.

- Comfortable working with a U.S.-based legal team.

- Employment Details



Position: Litigation Legal Assistant

Company: Triten Law

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 40 hours per week, aligned with required U.S. business hours

Compensation: $320 USD per week ($8/hour)

Work Arrangement: Initially remote, with the possibility of transitioning to onsite work in Metro Manila



Location Requirement: Applicants must currently reside in Metro Manila or be willing to relocate if an onsite arrangement becomes necessary.



How to Apply

Interested candidates may submit their applications through OnlineJobs.ph. Please attach your updated resume and answer the screening questions below.

- How many years of litigation support experience do you have?

- Have you previously supported a U.S.-based law firm? If yes, what types of cases did you handle?

- Which legal case management systems have you used? Please specify whether you have hands-on Filevine experience.

- Are you currently based in Metro Manila? If not, would you be willing to relocate if onsite work becomes necessary?

- What is your expected weekly compensation in USD?



We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:

THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training

title: Supply Chain Manager for Fashion E-commerce Store
description:
We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Manager for a growing fashion e-commerce / fashion dropshipping store. We are looking for someone who works accurately, takes responsibility, and makes sure orders are properly followed up after purchase: from fulfilment and tracking all the way to final delivery to the customer.



You will start with approximately 1 hour of work per day. As the store continues to grow and the number of orders increases, the workload and number of hours will also increase. Starting rate: $3 per hour.



🧠 Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience with supply chain, logistics, or order management within e-commerce or dropshipping

• Preferably has experience within fashion e-commerce or fashion dropshipping

• Has experience with ParcelPanel

• Understands fulfilment, tracking, and international shipping

• Has experience communicating directly with suppliers

• Works very accurately and is highly organised

• Can independently identify and solve problems

• Preferably identifies problems before they become bigger issues

• Takes responsibility for their work

• Speaks and writes English well

• Is reliable and consistently available

• Learns quickly

• Thinks proactively about how processes can be improved

• Is looking for a long-term position

Experience within fashion dropshipping is strongly preferred.



📦 Your Main Responsibilities

You will be responsible for the daily monitoring and follow-up of the supply chain of our fashion store. Your responsibilities include:

• Checking ParcelPanel daily

• Checking whether orders have correct tracking information

• Checking whether orders have actually been shipped

• Monitoring tracking statuses

• Checking whether shipments continue to move normally

• Making sure customers ultimately receive their orders

• Following up on open and delayed shipments

• Identifying unshipped orders and discussing them with the supplier

• Investigating missing tracking information

• Identifying incorrect or incomplete addresses

• Following up on missing house numbers and other address issues

• Checking and following up on Pick Up orders

• Identifying and following up on Return to Sender orders

• Identifying and following up on Lost in Transit orders

• Identifying and following up on Out of Stock orders

• Monitoring Shipment Delays daily

• Checking whether tracking statuses have changed

• Communicating directly with the supplier when there is an issue with an order or shipment

• Keeping Supply Chain Management Sheets accurate and up to date

• Recording issues in the correct tab

• Closing resolved issues correctly

• Identifying recurring shipping or fulfilment problems

• Reporting clearly each day which issues are still open and which have been resolved



🔍 Situations You Should Be Able to Recognise

You should be comfortable working with tracking and order statuses such as: Delivered, In Transit, Pick Up, Return to Sender, Bad Address, Address Error, Refused, Not Picked Up, Info Received, Unfulfilled, Out of Stock, Lost in Transit, Shipment Delay.



It is important that you understand which orders only need continued monitoring and which orders require action. We are not looking for someone who simply says: "This order has a problem." We want someone who immediately investigates: "Why did this happen, what is the current status, and what needs to be done to resolve it?"



🛠 Tools You Will Work With

Experience with the following tools is an advantage: ParcelPanel, Shopify, Supply Chain Management Sheets, 17Track, Yun Express, ParcelsApp, Slack, ReAmaze / Gorgias, Google Sheets.



🤝 Who Will You Work With?

You will work closely with:

• The store owner

• Our supplier

• Our Customer Support Representative

title: US Tax Specialist
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

Office.

title: Virtual Marketing Manager – Home Care Agency (US-Based)

About Us

Our mission is to help more seniors thrive at home by providing compassionate care that feels like support from a trusted friend. We are guided by Reciprocal Dignity: we honor our caregivers as much as our clients.

You will own the planning, execution, and tracking of our marketing across digital, print, and public relations. You will also collect and edit content from our local team and adapt national franchise campaigns for our communities. Finally, you will evaluate any proposed media spend before we commit to it. What We Offer

A mission-driven team that values dignity, kindness, and dependability

Room to grow as we expand into new markets

[Paid holidays / 13th month pay / performance bonus / other benefits]



How to Apply



Send the following:



Your resume

3–5 samples of your work, including at least one edited video or reel, plus a social media calendar, Google Business posts, a print piece, or a campaign you ran, with results if available

A short paragraph (under 150 words) on how you would d
 whether a $1,000 local sponsorship is worth it

title: iring: Mobile App UI Designer (Figma) | Flutter App Visual Redesign Project
description:
Project Type: Freelance / Fixed-Price Contract

Timeline: 2–3 Weeks

Location: Remote (Philippines Preferred)



About the Project



We are Safe Ride Foundation, a U.S.-based nonprofit organization that provides safe and reliable transportation services.



We recently launched a new mobile application called SOS Safe Ride, built using Flutter and available on iOS, Android, and web.



The app is already fully functional, but its current appearance is relatively generic. We are looking for an experienced UI Designer to give the application a professional, modern, and distinctive visual identity that better represents our brand.



This is a visual redesign, NOT a complete UX overhaul or app development project. We want to maintain the existing functionality and general layout while significantly improving the overall look and feel.



Scope of Work



The designer will be responsible for creating a comprehensive, cohesive visual theme for our existing mobile application.



This includes:



Color Palette: Develop a consistent color system incorporating our existing brand identity.



Buttons & Components: Design custom buttons, input fields, cards, menus, navigation bars, toggles, and other interface elements.



Icons: Design or select a consistent icon set that complements the new theme.



Backgrounds & Visual Elements: Create custom backgrounds, gradients, shapes, illustrations, and other decorative elements where appropriate.



Typography: Establish consistent fonts, text sizes, weights, and hierarchies.



Screen Designs: Apply the new theme across the application's existing screens.



Design System: Build a reusable, cascading design system in Figma so that visual elements remain consistent throughout the application.



Responsive Design: Ensure the designs are suitable for mobile devices and applicable web interfaces.



Our application includes interfaces for passengers, drivers, dispatchers, and administrators.



We anticipate approximately 20–30 unique screen designs, subject to an agreed screen inventory before work begins.



Deliverables



Upon completion, we expect:



A complete, editable Figma project containing all approved screen designs.



A reusable component library and design system with defined colors, typography, buttons, icons, and other UI elements.



All necessary visual assets exported in appropriate formats (SVG, PNG, etc.).



Documentation sufficient for our Flutter development team to implement the new theme.



Two rounds of revisions based on our feedback.



All final custom designs and assets will become the property of Safe Ride Foundation. Any third-party assets must be properly licensed for commercial use.



Required Skills



Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, and design variables.



Proven experience designing mobile application interfaces for iOS and Android.



Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, typography, color theory, and mobile design principles.



Experience creating reusable design systems rather than independently styling every screen.



Ability to work within an existing application structure and established brand identity.



Understanding of how to prepare designs for developer implementation.



Bonus Qualifications:



Experience designing interfaces for Flutter applications.



Familiarity with Flutter's Material Design and theming architecture.



Experience with transportation, booking, delivery, or location-based applications.



Experience preparing UI designs for responsive web applications.



Project Workflow



Phase 1: Discovery & Visual Direction



Review our current app, branding, and existing screens. Propose a visual direction and redesign 3–5 representative screens for our approval.



Phase 2: Full UI Design



Once the visual direction is approved, create the reusable component library and apply the new theme across the agreed application screens.



Phase 3: Finalization & Developer Handoff



Complete revisions, organize the Figma project, export assets, and provide documentation to our development team.



Our existing developers will handle all implementation and coding. You are not expected to write Flutter code.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your portfolio showing previous mobile app UI projects (Figma links preferred).



Examples of design systems or component libraries you have created.



Your experience working with Flutter developers, if applicable.



Confirmation that you can complete the project within our $800 fixed budget and 2–3 week timeline.



Important: We are looking for someone with demonstrated mobile application UI design experience, not simply a graphic designer who creates logos, marketing materials, or social media graphics.



Our goal is to give an already-functioning app a polished, recognizable visual identity that can be implemented efficiently by our development team.

title: AI solutions implementation and ongoing technical support.for small to medium businesses.
description:
**REMOTE CONTRACT ROLE — PHILIPPINES PREFERRED**

**Senior AI Receptionist and Automation Implementation and ongoing technical support Specialist**

**Maxon AI Results**



Maxon AI Results is building a business that helps small and midsize companies improve their operations with practical AI solutions.. Our first service will be an AI receptionist that can answer calls, respond to common questions, capture and qualify leads, schedule appointments, and trigger reliable follow\-up\.



We’re seeking an exceptionally capable technical specialist to help us build, test, launch, and support this service\. You would first help us set up and operate the receptionist system for Maxon AI Results, then help us adapt it for customers\. Over time, you may also help us introduce additional AI products and services\.



This is a direct working relationship with the business owner\. We are not looking for an agency salesperson or a consultant who only makes recommendations\. We need a hands\-on professional who can deliver working systems, document them clearly, and support them after launch\.



**What you will do**



- Recommend and configure appropriate AI voice receptionist and telephony tools\.

- Build call flows for greeting callers, answering approved questions, capturing contact details, routing calls, taking messages, and scheduling appointments\.

- Connect the receptionist to calendars, CRM systems,
, forms, and automation tools as needed\.

- Configure missed\-call responses, follow\-up messages, appointment confirmations, and reminders\.

- Test realistic call scenarios, identify failures, and improve the caller experience\.

- Set up reporting so we can track call volume, missed calls, appointments, lead details, and system issues\.

- Maintain and troubleshoot systems after launch; explain problems and resolutions in plain language\.

- Document each setup so it can be maintained, reviewed, and adapted for customers\.

- Help us evaluate and add other practical AI services as the business grows\.

- Protect customer and company information through careful access controls and sound data\-handling practices\.



**Required qualifications**



- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining AI voice agents, virtual receptionists, or comparable production phone systems\.

- Strong hands\-on experience with telephony or contact\-center platforms and integrations\.

- Experience connecting systems through APIs, webhooks, automation platforms, or native integrations\.

- Experience working with calendars, CRMs, and appointment\-booking workflows\.

- Ability to troubleshoot call quality, routing, transcription, scheduling, and integration problems\.

- Strong written and spoken English; able to explain technical decisions clearly to a nontechnical owner\.

- Excellent documentation habits and dependable follow\-through\.

- Able to work remotely and provide regular overlap with U\.S\. business hours\.

- References, work samples, or a live demonstration of systems you personally built\.



**Strong advantages**



- Experience serving HVAC, plumbing, electrical, property\-management, or other local service businesses\.

- Experience with consent, call recording, privacy, and data\-retention settings for voice systems\.

- Experience with CRM setup, lead qualification, analytics, and customer onboarding\.

- Experience supporting multiple client accounts without mixing customer data or access\.



**Initial engagement**



The role is expected to begin as a paid, part\-time contract of approximately 20 hours per week\. We will agree on the exact schedule and compensation based on demonstrated experience and the proposed scope\. We are looking for a long\-term technical partner as the customer base grows\.



The selection process will include a paid practical assignment\. The assignment will ask you to design and demonstrate a basic receptionist workflow, document the setup, and explain how you would test it\. We will not ask for unpaid production work or access to sensitive customer data during the assessment\.



**How to apply**



Please send:



1. A brief introduction and your location and time zone\.

2. A résumé or summary of relevant experience\.

3. Links, screenshots, or a short video showing systems you personally built\.

4. The platforms you used and exactly what you implemented\.

5. A short explanation of how you would build a receptionist that answers calls, captures leads, schedules appointments, and sends reminders\.

6. Your hourly or monthly rate and availability\.

7. Two professional references, if available\.



Applications that only list tools without showing what you personally built will not be considered\.

The Role

- Investigate public companies and verify financial claims against primary sources (yahoo finance, reuters, morning star, google finance, bloomberg, etc.)

- Able to interpret revenue growth, profit margins, earnings, debt, liquidity, cash generation, and valuation metrics

- Has identified financial statement trends YoY and QoQ using Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR)

- Can identify meaningful multi-year financial trends and explain why a metric matters (and its limitations)



2. SEC Filing Research

- Experience researching companies via 10-Ks, 10-Qs, earnings releases, and investor relations materials

- Able to locate and verify figures against original sources

- Understands reporting periods, accounting terminology, and accurate citations



3. Financial Writing & Content Development

- Strong written English; can explain complex financial concepts clearly to a retail audience

- Can turn research into company breakdowns, metric explainers, comparisons, social posts, and article outlines

- Distinguishes reported facts from interpretation and opinion



4. Organic Marketing & Audience Research

- Interested in value/fundamental investing and the retail investor community

- Can research relevant forums, newsletters, creators, and content platforms (Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads)

- Able to track engagement, referral traffic, and signups where measurable



Preferred Background

Especially value candidates with education/experience in:

- Finance, accounting, equity research, or investment research

- Financial journalism or writing about public companies

- Financial modeling, spreadsheet analysis, or company valuation

- SEO, content strategy, or social media marketing

- Experience with SEC EDGAR, spreadsheets, Canva, and scheduling tools is a plus, but financial research ability and writing quality matter more than any specific tool.



How to Apply

Please include:

- A brief introduction with your relevant experience and resume

- Your background in finance, accounting, research, or writing

- A writing sample (and an example of financial analysis, if available)

- A short explanation of how you'd research a public company using its latest annual report



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid financial research and writing exercise.

title: Overnight Dispatch Coordinator
description:
# Overnight Dispatch Coordinator



**Company:** Runners Holding Group  

**Location:** Remote  

**Positions Available:** 3  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  

**Working Hours:** Rotating overnight shifts between 11 PM and 9 AM Eastern Time (Toronto, Canada)  

**Schedule:** 5 shifts per week, 2 days off  

**Compensation:** Based on experience



## About the Position



We are a Canadian company operating delivery services across multiple cities.



We are looking for three reliable, organized, and proactive Overnight Dispatch Coordinators to manage delivery operations, coordinate drivers, verify payments, and ensure customer orders are completed successfully.



Our dispatch operation runs seven days a week. Three dispatchers will share responsibility for covering our core overnight operating hours.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Order Management & Dispatch



- Monitor incoming customer orders.

- Verify customer payments before dispatching orders.

- Assign orders to appropriate drivers based on location, availability, and delivery requirements.

- Monitor active deliveries and ensure orders are completed successfully.

- Follow up with drivers on delayed or outstanding orders.

- Update order statuses accurately in the dispatch system.

- Resolve routine delivery issues and escalate problems when necessary.



### 2. Driver Coordination



- Communicate with drivers throughout their shifts.

- Confirm driver availability and readiness to accept orders.

- Ensure drivers accept, process, and complete assigned deliveries.

- Follow up with drivers who are unresponsive or experiencing delays.

- Identify areas experiencing driver shortages.

- Communicate driver coverage requirements to management.



### 3. Operations Monitoring



- Monitor order activity across multiple cities.

- Identify cities experiencing high demand or insufficient driver coverage.

- Communicate staffing and coverage concerns to management.

- Track missed, delayed, cancelled, and completed orders.

- Maintain accurate operational records.

- Provide shift updates and handover reports.



### 4. Communication & Problem Solving



- Maintain clear communication with drivers and management.

- Respond promptly to operational issues.

- Resolve order assignment and delivery problems.

- Escalate payment discrepancies and unresolved delivery issues.

- Ensure smooth communication between dispatch shifts.



## Qualifications



- Previous experience in dispatch, logistics, delivery operations, or customer service preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong multitasking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple orders and drivers simultaneously.

- Comfortable using online ordering platforms, spreadsheets, and communication tools.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly when verifying payments.

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote working environment.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who:



- Takes responsibility for ensuring orders are completed.

- Communicates proactively with drivers and management.

- Can make quick decisions under pressure.

- Is dependable and punctual.

- Pays close attention to payment verification and order accuracy.

- Identifies operational problems before they become serious.

- Works well independently and as part of a team.



## Working Schedule



Our core dispatch hours are **11 PM to 9 AM Eastern Time, seven days a week**.



Three dispatchers will share coverage of these hours through a rotating schedule.



- Each dispatcher works five scheduled shifts per week.

- Each dispatcher receives two days off per week.

- Shifts may include weekends and holidays.

- Individual shift times and days off will be assigned based on operational requirements.

- All working hours follow Toronto, Canada time.



**Our priority is ensuring every order is properly assigned, monitored, and completed while maintaining adequate driver coverage across all operating cities.**

title: U.S. Tax Preparation Assistant / Accounting VA - Remote, Philippines | Paid Training | Leadership Opportunity
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a U.S.-based tax and accounting business looking for a dependable, detail-oriented accounting assistant in the Philippines to work remotely with our U.S.-based owner/accountant.



You will help organize client information, prepare supporting worksheets and draft tax forms, check calculations, and keep assignments on schedule.



We will provide hands-on training in our tax preparation procedures, software, and quality standards. You should already have a solid accounting foundation, good numerical skills, and the ability to follow detailed instructions.



We plan to hire within the next two to three months, initially for approximately 20 hours per week. There may be opportunities to increase to full-time as the business grows and you demonstrate proficiency.



COMPENSATION AND WORK ARRANGEMENT



* Starting rate: $4–$6 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills.

* Paid training: Scheduled training hours are paid at your agreed starting rate.

* Initial hours: Approximately 20 hours per week.

* Location: Fully remote, Philippines-based.

* Schedule: Agreed before starting, with some overlap with the U.S.-based accountant for training and review.

* Performance review: After the first 60–90 days.

* Growth: Potential for additional hours, higher compensation, and leadership responsibilities based on performance and business needs.

* Additional hours during tax season must be agreed in advance and will be paid at the agreed rate.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Collect, organize, and verify client information



* Review client questionnaires, intake forms, and supporting documents.

* Check that client names, addresses, taxpayer identification details, and other required information match the records provided.

* Confirm that each document belongs to the correct client and tax year.

* Maintain organized digital folders using the company’s filing procedures.

* Identify missing documents, duplicate records, incomplete answers, and conflicting information.

* Prepare clear questions for the supervising accountant and follow up with clients when authorized.



2. Prepare draft tax forms under supervision



* Enter verified client information into our approved tax preparation software.

* Prepare assigned sections of draft returns, schedules, and supporting worksheets.

* Learn the purpose of each relevant form, what its individual lines require, and how information connects across forms.

* Work with documents such as Forms W-2, 1099, and other records relevant to assigned clients.

* Assist with individual returns and, where required and appropriate to your training, business returns.

* Use the correct tax-year information and follow the company’s preparation instructions.

* Flag unfamiliar situations and request clarification before proceeding.



The U.S.-based accountant will oversee your work and handle final approval and filing. Assignments will reflect your training and demonstrated ability.



3. Check calculations and reconcile information



* Verify calculations, totals, and amounts transferred between documents, worksheets, and forms.

* Match entries to their supporting records.

* Check for missing amounts, duplicate entries, and inconsistent figures.

* Compare current information with prior-year records when instructed and flag unexplained differences.

* Prepare clear worksheets showing where figures came from.

* Assist with accounting reconciliations related to assigned tax work, within your training.



4. Review your work before submitting it



* Complete the company’s preparation and review checklists.

* Check data entry, document references, calculations, and completeness.

* Review software alerts and bring unresolved issues to the supervising accountant.

* Clearly identify items awaiting client information or professional review.

* Submit organized work with supporting documents and concise notes.

* Apply feedback carefully and use it to improve future assignments.



We value accuracy and clear communication. If information is missing or unclear, we expect you to ask rather than guess.



5. Track assignments and meet deadlines



* Maintain an updated tracker of client assignments, due dates, missing information, and review status.

* Provide regular progress updates.

* Report potential delays early.

* Attend scheduled training sessions and review meetings.

* Be available during agreed working hours.

* Communicate professionally with the owner, team members, and clients when authorized.



6. Protect confidential client information



* Use only company-approved software, accounts, storage, and communication channels.

* Follow confidentiality and information-security procedures.

* Keep client information private and secure.

* Never share client documents with unauthorized people or upload them to unapproved tools, including AI tools.

* Report suspected security issues immediately.



TRAINING AND YOUR FIRST ASSIGNMENTS



You will work closely with the owner/accountant during your initial training.



Training will cover:



* How to review client documents and identify missing information.

* How to understand assigned tax forms and their relevant lines.

* How to connect supporting records to the appropriate entries.

* How to use our software, worksheets, checklists, and tracking system.

* How to verify calculations and recognize inconsistencies.

* When to ask questions or escalate a situation for review.



You will begin with sample exercises and manageable supervised assignments. Your workload will increase as you demonstrate accuracy, understanding, and reliability.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* An accounting degree, related qualification, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

* A solid understanding of accounting fundamentals.

* Strong numerical skills and close attention to detail.

* Good written and spoken English.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain organized records.

* Willingness to learn, ask questions, accept feedback, and correct mistakes.

* A reliable computer, stable internet connection, and private workspace.

* Availability for agreed training sessions and working hours.



PREFERRED, BUT NOT REQUIRED



* Previous experience supporting a U.S. accounting or tax business.

* Familiarity with U.S. tax documents and preparation workflows.

* Experience with Drake, ProConnect, Lacerte, UltraTax, or similar tax software.

* QuickBooks Online experience.

* A Philippine CPA qualification.

* Experience documenting procedures or supporting other team members.



Previous U.S. tax experience is an advantage, but we will consider applicants with strong accounting fundamentals who are ready to learn.



Please describe your experience honestly, including which tasks you have completed independently and which required supervision.



HOW WE WILL EVALUATE SUCCESS



We will assess your:



* Accuracy when matching information to supporting documents.

* Ability to identify missing or conflicting information.

* Understanding of the tasks you have been trained to complete.

* Organization and ability to meet agreed deadlines.

* Communication and responsiveness during working hours.

* Progress in applying feedback and reducing repeated errors.

* Respect for client confidentiality.



FUTURE LEADERSHIP OPPORTUNITY



As the business grows, a consistently strong performer may have the opportunity to help build and manage a team.



Future responsibilities could include training new assistants, assigning tasks, monitoring deadlines, and checking work before submission to the U.S.-based accountant.



Leadership responsibilities and compensation would be discussed separately when the role develops. Promotion and pay increases are based on demonstrated ability and business needs.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject line:



U.S. Tax Accounting Assistant – [Your Name]



Include:



1. Your résumé and a short introduction.

2. Your accounting education, qualifications, and relevant experience.

3. Any U.S. tax preparation experience, including the forms you have worked with and your level of responsibility.

4. The accounting, tax, and spreadsheet software you have used.

5. Your availability in Philippine time and earliest start date.

6. Your expected starting rate within the advertised $4–$6 USD per hour range.

7. A brief example of an error or discrepancy you found and how you handled it, without sharing confidential information.



Please also answer this question:



“A client’s questionnaire shows one amount, but the supporting tax document shows a different amount. What would you do before completing the entry?”



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to an interview and a short paid practical assessment using fictional information. This will assess document matching, calculations, attention to detail, and ability to follow instructions.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in accurate work, communicates openly, and wants to develop their skills with our business.

title: Senior DTC Video Ads Editor | Full-Time Remote
description:
About Us



FDYS is a media-led outdoor, fishing and lifestyle business operating across multiple e-commerce verticals.



Across our brands, our YouTube channels have more than 3.7 million subscribers. Content is at the centre of what we do. It grows the audience, builds community and drives e-commerce demand.



As we scale our e-commerce brands, we’re looking for an experienced DTC video ads editor to join our team full time.



About the Role



This role is focused on editing video ads. It is not a general video editing, social media or YouTube editing role. We’re looking for a senior editor who has edited ads for DTC brands doing over USD $1M per month, and who understands what makes a video work as an ad.



You’ll be fully dedicated to FDYS and edit video ads across our e-commerce brands for Meta, TikTok, TikTok Shop and YouTube. You know what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching and click. You can take a brief and raw footage and turn it into a clean, engaging ad, then create the variations we need for testing.



If you’ve edited ads for outdoor, fashion or apparel brands (think the style and feel of Patagonia, The North Face and similar), you’ll feel right at home here.



Non-Negotiables



Please only apply if you meet all of the following:



At least 4 years of experience editing paid social video ads for DTC e-commerce brands.

Experience editing ads for at least one DTC brand doing over USD $1M per month in revenue (you must name the brand or brands in your application).

Proven skill in editing high-quality video ads for Meta 
 and Instagram), with examples in your portfolio.

Experience editing ads for outdoor (including fishing or adventure), fashion or apparel brands.

A portfolio of real, live paid ads, not general video edits.

Availability to work full time and be fully dedicated to FDYS (no other ongoing clients or jobs).

Availability to work 40 hours per week, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM AEST (including a 1-hour break), with no exceptions.

An updated, high-performance laptop or computer that can handle 4K footage and heavy editing smoothly (recent processor, at least 16GB RAM, SSD storage, and a dedicated graphics card or Apple Silicon chip).

A fast and reliable internet connection, with a backup option (such as mobile data or a pocket Wi-Fi) for outages.



Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be considered.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your experience is mainly YouTube videos, vlogs, weddings, events or corporate videos.

You are looking for a general content creation or social media editing role.

You have not edited ads that were run with paid spend.

You need step-by-step direction on every edit.

You are not comfortable receiving honest feedback and iterating quickly.



What You’ll Do



Edit high-quality video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube from creative briefs and footage provided by the team, including UGC-style, founder-led, product demo, lifestyle and testimonial ad formats.

Edit TikTok Shop video ads that showcase our products clearly and naturally.

Use strong storytelling and pacing to make every ad engaging from the first second to the CTA.

Create multiple variations of each ad (hooks, intros, CTAs and aspect ratios) for testing.

Turn long-form YouTube and adventure footage, plus B-roll, into short, scroll-stopping ads.

Apply feedback from the media buyer and marketing team to improve the next round of edits.

Suggest fresh editing styles, formats and hook ideas you’ve seen working in DTC ads.

Keep our ad creative library organised, labelled and easy to find.

Work closely with our founders, Head of Marketing and Operations, media buyer and other video editors.



Required Skills and Experience



A strong eye for what makes a video ad work, including hooks, pacing, captions, sound design and clear CTAs.

Strong storytelling skills in short-form video ads.

Expertise in editing with B-roll and creating TikTok Shop ads.

Skilled in motion graphics and animated text overlays for ads.

Able to work from scripts and creative briefs while bringing your own editing ideas.

Experience editing ads for Australian or US brands.

A basic understanding of ad metrics such as hook rate and CTR, and how editing choices affect them.

Advanced skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve.

Fast turnaround without losing quality, and able to manage multiple ad batches each week.

Clear English communication and honest, timely updates.



What We Offer



A full-time, long-term remote role with a growing Australian business.

Creative freedom in how you edit, with a say in the ad ideas we try.

A supportive, honest team culture where your ideas are heard.

Room to grow as our e-commerce brands scale.



How to Apply



To apply, please send the following:



1. A short introduction video



Record a short video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.



Please upload it to Google Drive, Loom or another platform where we can easily watch it, then include the link in your application.



Important: The video is a required part of the application. This role requires strong attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to follow instructions. Applications without a video will not be considered.



2. Your CV and ads portfolio



Please include your CV, along with:



Your portfolio of paid ads only (links to live ads or an ads reel, not general edits), including at least three Meta video ads you’ve edited. Applications without an ads portfolio will not be reviewed.

The DTC brands you’ve edited ads for and their approximate monthly revenue.

The ad you’re most proud of, with a short note on why you think it worked as an ad (results are a bonus if you have them).

Any TikTok Shop ads you’ve edited, if available.

Your laptop or computer specs (processor, RAM and graphics card).

Your available start date.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview.



To show you’ve read this post, start your application with the words “FDYS Ads”. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

title: Phone Sales Rep: Cold Calls, Appointment Setting, and Closing (GoHighLevel Required)
description:
We run an online directory of local home service businesses in the US (tree service, HVAC, septic, chimney, pest control, garage doors, and similar trades). Most owners don't yet know they have a free listing with us. Your job is to call them, confirm their information, verify their listing, book a short 10-minute call, and walk them through a free report on their business and sell our marketing service on that call.



This is a phone sales role, not just appointment setting. You will follow a detailed script and work entirely inside GoHighLevel. We do not have time to teach GoHighLevel from scratch, so please only apply if you have already used it for real work.



SCHEDULE (2 days a week to start, 16 hours)

Tuesday and Thursday to start, with more days added as the business grows. Our goal is to grow this role into full time. You'll always get at least a week's notice before any schedule change. Each shift is 10:00 am to 6:30 pm US Eastern Time:

- 10:00 am to 12:00 pm: calling

- 12:00 to 12:15 pm: break (paid)

- 12:15 to 2:00 pm: calling

- 2:00 to 2:30 pm: lunch (unpaid)

- 2:30 to 5:00 pm: calling

- 5:00 to 5:15 pm: break (paid)

- 5:15 to 6:30 pm: calling

In the Philippines, this is a night shift: about 11:00 pm to 7:30 am Manila time from November to March, and one hour earlier from March to November.



PAY

$6 an hour, starting with a paid trial week. Paid weekly.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make outbound calls to business owners from a GoHighLevel smart list, using the browser dialer.

- Confirm each business's phone, service area, website, and owner name, and update the contact as you talk.

- Offer to verify their free listing, and read a text consent question word for word before anything is texted.

- Book 10-minute walkthrough calls on a GoHighLevel calendar.

- Run the walkthroughs: text the owner their report, go through their reviews, Google profile, website, and a missed-call calculator with their own numbers, then offer our service ($297 a month) and smaller options.

- Stay on the line while the owner pays through a link you text them. You never take card numbers.

- Call businesses to pass along quote requests from homeowners.

- Handle objections calmly using our script, and set callbacks and follow ups.

- Log every call: notes, tags, custom fields, pipeline stages, tasks, and calendar bookings in GoHighLevel.

- Follow US calling rules exactly: calling hours, call recording notice, do-not-call requests, and text consent.



REQUIRED

- At least 6 months of hands-on GoHighLevel experience. You should already know how to: call from the GoHighLevel dialer, work from smart lists, update custom fields and tags, move opportunities between pipeline stages, book appointments on calendars, create tasks, add notes, and insert text snippets in Conversations.

- At least 1 year of outbound cold calling for US clients, including closing sales over the phone, not only booking appointments.

- Clear, natural English with a neutral or American-sounding accent.

- Able to follow a script word for word where required, and sound friendly and natural doing it.

- Computer with Google Chrome, a USB or Bluetooth headset with a mic, a quiet room, and stable internet (plus a backup).

- Available every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday for the full schedule above, so we can add days as we grow.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience calling contractors or home service businesses.



HOW WE WORK

- You get a complete written script and a short readiness quiz before your first call.

- Your calls are recorded and reviewed so we can help you improve.

- Paid trial week first, at the full rate. If it's a good fit, this is a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.

1. Start your message with the word HOMEPRO.

2. Send a link to a voice recording (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or similar) of you reading these two lines naturally, as if on a real call:



"Hi, is this Mike? Mike, it's [your name] over at Local Pro Directory. Mike's Tree Service has a free listing in our tree service directory for Camp Hill, and homeowners request quotes through it, so I'm on a quick recorded call to make sure the info on it is right. Do you have one minute?"



"To send you those quote alerts, I need your OK. Is it OK if Local Pro Directory texts you at the number you provided regarding your listing and quote requests? Message and data rates may apply, and you can reply STOP anytime."



3. In 3 to 5 sentences, describe your cold calling and closing experience: what you sold, to whom, and roughly how many sales you closed in a typical month.

4. In 2 to 3 sentences, describe what you have done in GoHighLevel and for which kind of business. A screenshot of a pipeline or calendar you managed is a plus.

5. Confirm you can work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, 10:00 am to 6:30 pm US Eastern.
