• When a caregiver reaches a milestone, send a personalized congratulations
 within 48 hours and coordinate the reward so it is mailed within 1–2 weeks.

• Keep the “Save Our Shifts!” (SOS!) superhero spirit alive with announcements, leaderboards and celebrations.

• Help explain the program to new caregivers by preparing materials used at weekly orientation.

• Spot trends (who is stretching, how often, which shifts are hardest to fill) and suggest improvements to the program.



2. Build our caregiver community on social media

• Create and manage a dedicated, private
 page or group just for our caregivers.

• Plan and post a regular content calendar: caregiving tips, encouragement, reminders, birthdays, work anniversaries and agency news.

• Publish weekly shout-outs celebrating caregivers who go above and beyond, including Stretch Perks™ milestones and compliments from clients and families.

• Moderate the community so it stays positive, respectful and protective of client privacy (no client names, photos or health details without written permission).

• Encourage engagement through polls, questions, photo challenges and “caregiver spotlight” features.

• Support caregiver-facing content on the agency’s other social channels as needed.

3. Plan events, themed weeks and contests

• Build an annual calendar of caregiver appreciation moments, including National Caregivers Month (November), holidays and agency milestones.

• Design themed weeks (for example, Superhero SOS! Week or Self-Care Week) with daily activities and prizes.

• Run contests and challenges with clear rules, fair judging and documented winners.

• Coordinate virtual events and support in-person gatherings at our Augusta and Lake Country offices — invitations, RSVPs, agendas, supplies lists and follow-up.

• Manage a recognition and events budget and keep receipts and records organized.

4. Recordkeeping and administration

• Keep accurate, up-to-date spreadsheets and logs for points, rewards sent, contest entries, winners and event attendance.

• Double-check every record before rewards are issued or names are announced.

• Prepare a short monthly Caregiver Experience report: stretches recorded, rewards issued, community engagement and upcoming events.

• Collect caregiver feedback through simple surveys and share themes with leadership.

• Follow all agency policies on confidentiality and the protection of caregiver and client information.

Qualifications

Required

• 2+ years of experience in a virtual assistant, community management, HR support, employee engagement or events role.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, upbeat and professional tone.

• Exceptional recordkeeping and attention to detail — you catch errors before they happen.

• Strong skills in Google Sheets or Excel, Google Workspace and
.

• Hands-on experience creating and managing
 pages or groups, including scheduling posts and moderating comments.

• Basic graphic design skills using Canva or a similar tool.

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet and a backup power or internet plan.

• Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours.

Preferred

• Experience supporting a U.S. healthcare, home care or other people-first business.

• Experience running recognition, rewards or loyalty programs.

• Familiarity with home care scheduling software (we use WellSky).

• Basic video editing for short celebration clips and reels.

The person we’re looking for

• A natural cheerleader. You light up when you celebrate other people’s wins.

• Detail-obsessed. Every point, date and name is right, every time.

• Creative. You have a steady stream of ideas for themes, contests and posts.

• Dependable. You follow through on deadlines without reminders.

• Kind and discreet. You treat every caregiver with dignity and protect private information.

How Success Is Measured

• 100% of qualifying stretches are logged accurately, with congratulations sent within 48 hours and rewards mailed within 1–2 weeks.

• The caregiver
 community is active, positive and growing, with at least one shout-out every week.

• At least one themed week, contest or event happens every month.

• Caregivers tell us they feel appreciated and connected to the team.

How to Apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Your resume.

2. A short video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself and telling us about a time you celebrated someone’s great work.

3. A sample
 shout-out post (text and, if you like, a Canva graphic) celebrating a caregiver who picked up a last-minute shift to make sure a senior wasn’t left without care.

Please include the words “Save Our Shifts” in the subject line of your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software.  Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

*Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

*Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed



Job Type: Full-time

Schedule:   Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–2:00 PM US Central standard time // 8PM to 4AM Philippine Time

Salary Range: Php 160,
,000 monthly, Depending on experience



Full-Time Performance Bonuses:



We believe exceptional professionals deserve competitive compensation, meaningful

opportunities to grow, and a work environment that supports their lives outside the

Office.



*Our full-time team bonuses include:

Generous Paid Time Off: Accrues at 21 paid days annually, increasing to 30 days after three years.

*Extended Weekends: One four-day weekend each month during our off-season, separate from regular PTO.

* Quarterly Profit-Sharing Bonuses: Opportunities to share in the firm’s financial success.

*Health Benefits: Health insurance reimbursement for you and your family.

* In-Home Support: Monthly allowance toward household assistance or childcare.

* Internet Allowance: Monthly reimbursement for reliable home internet.

* 13th-Month Bonus: Additional month’s compensation after one year.

 *Work-Life Balance: A consistent 40-hour workweek with no mandatory overtime, including during tax season.

 *Professional Growth: Opportunities to deepen your tax strategy expertise, expand your responsibilities, and advance within our growing firm.

title: Full-time WFH Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM) - $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400 p/m)
description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: This position is currently full, but new spots can open at any time as our team grows. We're still accepting applications and interviewing qualified candidates for our waitlist. If you're a good fit, you'll be among the first people we reach out to when a spot opens!



This role is for a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050-$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30-$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20-25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30-45 minutes. Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: "TOM" + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. We run multiple brands. Once hired for this position, you'll work for this brand:

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Project Engineer with proven experience in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering IT projects on time, within budget, and in accordance with the organization’s goals. You will work closely with clients, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure the seamless integration of technical solutions.

Project Planning & Management:

Documentation & Reporting:

Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

Strong technical background with experience in IT infrastructure, networking, cloud services, and cybersecurity.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage client relationships and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Experience in agile project management methodologies.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
KIN Super Supps was born from a simple idea: our dogs deserve better. Better ingredients, better science, and better support, especially as they age.



We launched our first line of advanced functional supplements in the US earlier this year and we're growing fast - dogs doing well, owners recommending us to their friends, and more dog parents finding us every week. Every formula is science-backed, transparently made, and crafted with the same care we'd want for our own dogs.



We're looking for an AI Video Editor to own the video creative that tells our story. You'll generate, edit, and stitch together AI-powered videos - UGC-style ads, animations, product explainers, and short-form social content - using tools like Higgsfield and ElevenLabs alongside traditional editing.



We're looking for someone who is obsessed with what AI video can do right now, has the taste to make it look and sound real, and cares about dogs enough to tell their stories well. You'll own your output, have the freedom to experiment with new tools and formats, and grow as fast as your work does.



As an early stage brand, we're building our creative engine from the ground up. That means real opportunity to shape how KIN looks and moves on screen - not just the videos you make, but the workflows and systems behind them.





You'll Love This Role If:



• You're always testing the newest AI video tools. You know what dropped this week, what it's good at, and where it still breaks. You'd happily spend an evening figuring out how to make a generated dog's fur move naturally.

• You genuinely love dogs. Most of our videos are about dogs, their health, and the people who love them. If you notice when a dog's walk looks wrong, you're already ahead.

• You like owning something and running with it, instead of waiting to be told what to do next.

• You care about work that's actually good, not just getting it out the door. You can tell when AI footage feels off, and you don't ship it until it doesn't.





Responsibilities



You'll produce video across three areas, all feeding the same goal: video that sells. You'll work with our media buyer, copywriters, and marketing lead to turn briefs into finished creative and learn from what performs.



1. AI UGC and ad creative

• Generate realistic UGC-style videos with AI avatars, talking heads, and dog footage, using Higgsfield and similar tools

• Produce voiceovers and character voices in ElevenLabs that sound like real dog parents, not robots

• Turn one script into multiple hooks, angles, and variations so our media buyer always has fresh creative to test



2. Animation and explainers

• Create animated product explainers that make our ingredients and science easy to understand

• Build motion graphics, text overlays, and visual storytelling that stay on brand



3. Editing and stitching

• Stitch AI-generated clips, stock, and real footage into seamless, polished videos

• Use GPT-6 Astra and other AI assistants to speed up scripting, shot lists, prompting, and repetitive editing work

• Edit, caption, and format videos for Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and our website

• Build and document repeatable workflows so we can produce more, faster, without dropping quality





Requirements



Experience

• A portfolio of AI video work that speaks for itself

• Hands-on experience creating AI-generated video, either for a brand, an agency, or your own projects

• Strong, hands-on with these AI tools:

   - Higgsfield for AI video generation, UGC avatars, and animation

   - ElevenLabs for AI voiceovers and character voices

   - GPT-6 Astra for scripting, shot lists, prompting, and automating parts of the edit

   - Other AI video and image generators as needed, to stitch clips into one seamless video



Skills

The right person for this role must have these skills:



• AI video generation. You're strong in Higgsfield and comfortable with other generators. You know how to prompt for consistency across shots, fix the uncanny moments, and get usable footage fast.

• AI voice and audio. You're strong in ElevenLabs. You can direct a voice for tone, pacing, and emotion, and mix it cleanly with music and sound.

• AI-assisted workflow. You use GPT-6 Astra (or similar) to plan, script, prompt, and automate parts of your editing, so you ship more without cutting corners.

• Editing and storytelling. You can stitch clips into a video with a strong hook, clear pacing, and a reason to keep watching. You understand what makes short-form ads and social videos work.

• Product and audience understanding. You can pick up what dog parents worry about and how our supplements help, so your videos feel real to them. We've done a lot of the groundwork already, so a big part of this is learning it quickly.





Results



Success in this role is measured by:



Creative performance

Your videos win. Ads you make hit strong hook rates, watch time, and ROAS, and more of our winning ads come from your work month on month. You work with the media buyer to learn what's working and build on it.



Output and workflow

You ship a steady flow of finished videos and variations every week and hit your deadlines. You work smoothly with our copywriters, media buyer, and marketing lead, take feedback well, and turn it around quickly.



Representing KIN well

Everything you put out looks and sounds like KIN. AI footage that feels real, dogs that move like dogs, and a brand dog parents trust.





What's In It For You



• Work at the frontier of AI video. You'll use the newest tools on real campaigns with real spend behind them, and see exactly how your work performs.

• Do work you can be excited about, if you love dogs. You'll help dogs live healthier, more comfortable lives, and help the people who love them do right by them.

• Freedom to experiment with new tools, formats, and styles, alongside an experienced marketing team you'll learn a lot from.

• A small team that trusts you to do great work. No approval chains, no micro-management. You'll be supported by seniors and peers, but you own your craft and your output.

• Performance bonuses tied to measurable results, with growth structures in place as your creative wins.

• A clear path into a creative or video lead role as we grow.





Key Questions For Candidates



To help us understand your expertise and fit for this role, please answer the following questions thoughtfully and honestly. Feel free to share examples that best show your potential and passion for the craft.



1. If you're a dog parent, tell us about your dog (or dogs). If you're not, tell us why you love dogs.



2. Share 2-3 AI videos you've made that you're proud of. For each, tell us which tools you used, how you made it, and what you'd improve.



3. Walk us through how you'd make a 30-second UGC-style ad for a dog joint supplement, from script to final export, using Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and anything else you'd reach for.



4. What's one AI video tool or technique you've picked up in the last month, and what did it change about how you work?



*Portfolio required. Applications without links to AI video work won't be considered.

title: Bookkeeper & Practice Administration Contractor
description:
VentureX is a New Zealand recruitment specialist connecting Kiwi businesses directly with dedicated offshore talent in the Philippines.



Unlike traditional BPO agencies that rotate shared staff, charge ongoing markups, or add bureaucratic friction, VentureX operates on a direct-hire model. VentureX manages the upfront screening, practical skills assessments, and remote setup checks so employers can hire and manage their own offshore team members directly.



We are recruiting an experienced Philippine-based bookkeeper for a long-term contractor role supporting an established New Zealand accounting firm. Working directly with the Practice Director, you will run the backend accounting engine to keep client accounts tidy, compliant, and on schedule.



You will have a guaranteed baseline of 10 hours per week, providing steady, predictable work. During the peak New Zealand tax and filing season from May to August, additional hours will be available by mutual agreement. 



Core Responsibilities

Your day-to-day focus covers bookkeeping, payroll runs, and tax filing administration. You will manage weekly, fortnightly, and monthly payroll processing and file payday records with Inland Revenue (IRD). In Xero, you will code general ledgers, complete bank reconciliations, process supplier bills, issue sales invoices, and organize source documents inside Hubdoc. You will also help prepare GST and income tax returns, track IRD statutory deadlines, submit Companies Office annual returns, and set up new client files and engagement paperwork in Xero Practice Manager.



Candidate Requirements

You must bring demonstrable experience working inside Xero, Xero Practice Manager, and Hubdoc. Candidates with direct background supporting New Zealand accounting practices, running Kiwi payroll, and handling IRD compliance will take priority. You need sharp attention to detail, strict standards around data security, and an independent work ethic.



Role Progression

The Practice Director handles all final sign-offs and client communications at the start while you settle into the firm's systems. As you demonstrate consistency, accuracy, and mastery of New Zealand compliance requirements, your scope will expand to include direct client liaison, workflow management, and practice administration.

title: Experienced Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Care Coordinator – U.S. Podiatry Practice
description:
We are an established, busy private podiatry and sports medicine practice in Pennsylvania, USA, looking for a highly organized, dependable, experienced **Medical Virtual Assistant / Patient Care Coordinator** for a long-term position.



This is a combination of **medical receptionist, patient scheduling coordinator, and medical administrative assistant**.



You will be responsible for answering patient calls, managing appointments, reviewing daily schedules, preparing patient charts, ensuring new-patient paperwork is completed, retrieving and uploading medical documents, and following through on outstanding patient requests.



We need someone who works independently, anticipates what needs to be completed, and does not require repeated reminders.



HOURS AND PAY



- $6–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

- Approximately 20–25 hours per week initially.

- Opportunity to increase to 30–40 hours per week for the right candidate.

- Must be available during assigned U.S. Eastern Time hours.

- Paid training and evaluation period.

- Performance and compensation review after 90 days.

- Long-term position.



During lower call volume, you are expected to independently review schedules, prepare patient charts, retrieve documents, and complete outstanding administrative tasks.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



 1. Patient Calls, Scheduling, and Communication



- Answer incoming patient calls professionally and promptly.

- Schedule new and established patient appointments using established protocols.

- Reschedule, cancel, and confirm appointments and procedures.

- Return missed calls and voi
s promptly.

- Monitor patient text messages, portal messages, and appointment requests throughout the shift.

- Contact patients regarding scheduling changes and physician instructions.

- Communicate professionally with frustrated or concerned patients.

- Escalate clinical concerns and urgent patient issues appropriately.

- Document patient communications accurately in the electronic medical record.

- Follow patient requests through to resolution.



 2. Daily and Upcoming Schedule Review



- Review the daily and upcoming appointment schedules for completeness and accuracy.

- Verify correct appointment types, visit durations, and scheduling requirements.

- Identify scheduling errors, missing information, and appointments requiring follow-up.

- Identify new patients who have not completed their required paperwork.

- Ensure patients have received the correct intake forms before their appointments.

- Identify missing referrals, insurance information, and other administrative requirements.

- Contact patients when scheduling clarification or outstanding information is needed.

- Coordinate changes with the front-office team.



**The goal is to identify and correct problems before the patient arrives, rather than waiting until the appointment.**



 3. New-Patient Intake and Chart Preparation



- Send new-patient registration packets and required forms through IntakeQ.

- Monitor completion of new-patient and annual-update paperwork.

- Follow up with patients who have not completed required forms.

- Retrieve completed forms from IntakeQ and other authorized systems.

- Upload documents into the correct patient chart in DrChrono.

- Verify that uploaded documents belong to the correct patient and are appropriately categorized.

- Ensure required registration, medical history, medication, allergy, demographic, and insurance information is available for staff review.

- Identify missing or incomplete paperwork and notify the appropriate team member.

- Review upcoming appointments to ensure administrative chart preparation is complete.



4. Medical Records and Document Management



- Retrieve and process incoming faxes, medical records, and documents.

- Request records from referring physicians, specialists, hospitals, and imaging facilities.

- Obtain available MRI, X-ray, laboratory, and other diagnostic reports.

- Upload documents into the appropriate patient charts.

- Verify that documents are complete, legible, correctly labeled, and filed under the correct patient.

- Follow up on outstanding medical-record requests until received.

- Track missing imaging reports and referrals.

- Communicate missing information to the appropriate staff member or physician.

- Handle authorized records releases according to office protocols.



5. Insurance and Additional Administrative Support



- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits.

- Identify missing referrals or insurance requirements.

- Assist with prior authorizations and precertifications.

- Contact insurance companies and healthcare facilities for follow-up.

- Follow up with new-patient inquiries.

- Assist with assigned documentation and administrative projects.

- Maintain organized tracking of outstanding tasks and follow-ups.



6. Task Management and End-of-Day Accountability



We place a strong emphasis on accurate task completion and follow-through.



You will be expected to:



- Review assigned patient flags and messages throughout the day.

- Prioritize time-sensitive patient requests.

- Carry out physician instructions promptly.

- Follow up on requests assigned to other staff members when necessary.

- Communicate immediately when a patient issue cannot be resolved.

- Never consider a task completed simply because it has been forwarded.

- Maintain an accurate list of outstanding patient issues.

- Provide a daily end-of-day report identifying completed and unresolved tasks.

- Ensure no patient message or scheduling issue is overlooked.



 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- At least two years of experience in a U.S. medical office or as a medical virtual assistant strongly preferred.

- Significant experience answering patient calls and scheduling appointments.

- Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation that U.S. patients can easily understand.

- Excellent written English.

- Experience using electronic medical records and scheduling software.

- Experience handling patient registration, medical documents, and intake forms.

- Ability to retrieve, organize, and upload documents accurately.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors independently.

- Excellent time management and organizational skills.

- Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities.

- Strong problem-solving skills and proactive communication.

- Ability to follow detailed instructions and established medical office protocols.

- Knowledge of HIPAA and patient confidentiality.

- Reliable attendance, internet connection with backup, and a quiet professional workspace.

- Comfortable working independently and as part of a remote and in-office team.



Preferred software experience:



- DrChrono

- RingCentral

- IntakeQ

- Google Workspace

- Other U.S. medical EHR and patient scheduling systems



Podiatry, orthopedics, sports medicine, or outpatient specialty experience is a plus.



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS POSITION?



We are looking for someone who notices problems before being asked.



For example:

- You review tomorrow's schedule and see a new patient has not completed the intake packet. You follow up and ensure the missing information is addressed.

- You see that an MRI follow-up appointment is scheduled but the report is not in the patient's chart. You contact the imaging facility and follow up.

- A patient texts about tomorrow's procedure. You respond promptly according to office protocols and obtain clarification from the clinical team when necessary.

- You receive a medical document. You verify the correct patient and upload it to the appropriate chart location.

- You identify a scheduling problem. You address it rather than leaving it for the physician or another staff member to discover.

- If you cannot resolve an issue, you escalate it and document the next action.



We value accuracy, initiative, accountability, and completing tasks—not simply reporting the number of calls or tasks handled.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words **"PATIENT FIRST"**.



Please provide:



1. Your résumé.

2. Your desired hourly rate in USD.

3. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time.

4. Whether you are seeking part-time work or are open to full-time hours.

5. The U.S. medical specialties you have supported.

6. The EHR, scheduling, and phone systems you have used.

7. Your internet and power backup plan.

8. A 3–5 minute voice recording answering the screening questions below.



VOICE SCREENING QUESTIONS



Please answer naturally in English, using your own words.



1. Medical Office Experience



Describe your experience working for U.S. medical practices. What percentage of your work involved answering patient phone calls, scheduling appointments, and preparing patient charts?



2. Schedule Review and Patient Paperwork



You are reviewing tomorrow's schedule. There are four new patients, two have not completed their intake forms, and one patient's insurance information is missing. Explain exactly how you would handle this.



3. Document Retrieval and Upload



A patient is scheduled tomorrow for an MRI review, but the MRI report is missing from the chart. What steps would you take to obtain the report, upload it correctly, and make sure the provider has it before the appointment?



4. Patient Communication



At 2:00 PM, a physician instructs you to contact a patient and reschedule tomorrow's procedure. At 3:30 PM, the patient texts asking whether they should still come in. What would you do?



5. Prioritization



You have incoming calls, unanswered voi
s, incomplete new-patient forms, an insurance verification, and several medical documents to upload. Explain how you would organize your work to ensure nothing is missed.



6. Accountability and Follow-Through



You discover that a patient message assigned to you yesterday was overlooked. The patient has now contacted the office again. Explain what you would do.



 APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

Applications without the requested information and voice recording will not be considered.



Please do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated answers. We want to hear your natural communication style, judgment, and problem-solving skills.



Selected applicants will complete a live interview and paid practical assessment using fictional patient scenarios.



We are looking for a dependable long-term team member who can independently manage patient communication, scheduling, paperwork, and administrative follow-through while helping our practice run efficiently.

title: Business Operations Lead
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a highly capable, proactive Business Operations Lead to work closely with the Owner and leadership team to bring structure, accountability, and execution across the business.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and knows how to turn ideas into action. You’ll help manage day-to-day operations, lead strategic projects, improve systems and processes, and ensure priorities consistently move from planning to completion.

The ideal candidate is an organized problem-solver and natural operator who takes ownership, anticipates what needs to happen next, and doesn’t need to be micromanaged. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, working through ambiguity, and finding solutions when processes or systems aren’t working.



What You’ll Do



Business Operations & Execution

Oversee day-to-day business operations, workflows, and processes

Create structure around priorities, projects, and initiatives across the organization

Turn leadership goals and ideas into clear action plans and measurable deliverables

Monitor progress, identify delays or roadblocks, and ensure projects stay on track

Establish accountability and follow through with team members, vendors, and stakeholders

Identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions

Process & Systems Improvement

Build, document, and maintain clear SOPs, workflows, and processes

Evaluate existing systems and continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency

Help develop scalable processes that support business growth

Optimize CRM systems, communication tools, and internal workflows

Identify opportunities for automation and eliminate unnecessary manual work

Ensure processes are consistently followed and updated as the business evolves



Project Management

Lead projects from initial planning through successful completion

Create timelines, assign responsibilities, track deliverables, and manage deadlines

Coordinate cross-functional projects and keep stakeholders informed

Maintain visibility into project status, priorities, and outstanding action items

Proactively follow up to prevent tasks from falling through the cracks

Help leadership prioritize competing initiatives based on urgency and business impact

Founder & Leadership Support

Work directly with the Founder on strategic and operational initiatives

Take ownership of projects that require research, coordination, organization, and execution

Prepare updates, reports, and summaries to help leadership make informed decisions

Anticipate needs and bring solutions—not just problems—to leadership

Act as a trusted operational partner who helps turn strategic priorities into results

Administrative & Vendor Management

Coordinate vendors, purchasing, invoicing, and other administrative processes

Maintain organized records, documentation, and operational information

Help manage vendor relationships and ensure deliverables are completed on time

Support other operational needs as the business grows



What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in Business Operations, Project Management, Executive Support, Operations Management, or a related role

Demonstrated ability to take ownership and drive projects from start to finish

Strong project management, organization, and time-management skills

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Experience supporting founders, executives, startups, or growing businesses preferred

Experience creating and implementing SOPs, workflows, and operational systems

Familiarity with CRM platforms, project management tools, automation, and business systems

Experience with home service industry CRMS (such as Housecall Pro, Service Titan, Jobber, etc.), Slack, Google Workspace, or similar platforms

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

Highly proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented

Strong follow-through and accountability

Comfortable working independently with minimal direction

Able to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment

Comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and solving problems without waiting to be asked



The Ideal Candidate

You’re someone who naturally thinks:

“What needs to happen next, and how can I make sure it gets done?”

You don’t wait for someone to tell you every step. You see a problem, investigate it, develop a solution, and take action.

You’re highly organized but also adaptable. You can move between strategic projects and operational details without losing sight of the bigger picture. You communicate clearly, follow through on commitments, and hold yourself and others accountable.

Most importantly, you’re a doer. You enjoy creating order out of chaos, improving the way a business operates, and helping leadership turn big ideas into measurable results.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Projects consistently move forward without constant oversight

Leadership has clear visibility into priorities, deadlines, and outstanding items

SOPs and systems are organized, documented, and easy for the team to follow

Operational bottlenecks are identified and resolved proactively

Workflows become more efficient and scalable over time

Fewer tasks fall through the cracks

The Founder and leadership team have more time to focus on growth and strategy

The business runs with greater structure, accountability, and consistency

title: Meta Media Buyer — Landscaping & Outdoor Living Lead Gen (3+ yrs, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
We're Prospr Media, a US-based marketing agency. We run Meta ads and content for home service companies, and we're going deep into landscaping and outdoor living — artificial turf, hardscapes, patios, outdoor kitchens, pools and decks.



We currently manage 12 active client accounts and we're growing fast. This is a stable, long-term, full-time seat on a team that's expanding, not a short-term project that disappears in three months.



What You'll Be Doing



You'll own Meta ad accounts for our landscaping and outdoor living clients end to end: campaign structure, budgets, testing, scaling, and killing what isn't working. You'll also brief and help assemble creative — static images, AI-generated visuals, text overlays, simple design work — because in this niche the creative is the lever, not the targeting.



You'll report directly to the founder. You'll have real ownership of your accounts, and we want someone who improves our systems, not just someone who executes inside them. If you see something broken in how we run ads, we want to hear it.



Who We're Looking For



3+ years running Meta lead gen for high-ticket home improvement — landscaping, hardscapes, turf, pools, outdoor living, remodeling, decks or similar. The more accounts you've personally run, the better. If you've managed 10+ accounts, we want to see all of it.

Real account ownership — you've personally managed ad accounts and budgets, not "assisted" on them

You understand high-ticket, long sales cycles — a $40k hardscape job doesn't close in 48 hours, and cheap leads are often worthless leads

Comfortable with creative — briefing concepts, AI image tools, text overlays, basic design

Fluent written English

Full-time, with meaningful overlap with US Eastern time

Nice To Have



Direct experience with turf, hardscape or outdoor living clients specifically

Experience with GoHighLevel

Experience managing seasonal budget swings (spring/summer surge, winter pullback)

What We Offer



$1,200 – $1,800/month depending on track record, paid on time, every time

Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency — we want you here in two years, not two months

Performance bonuses as the accounts you run grow

Real autonomy and direct access to the founder, no layers of management

How To Apply — Read This Carefully, We Delete Applications That Skip Steps



Reply with all three of these:



Screenshots of ad accounts you personally ran for home improvement or home service clients, with spend and cost per lead visible. Blur client names if you need to. Send as many as you have — one is the minimum, five is better, ten is better than five. If you've run 20 accounts, show us 20. Put them in a single Google Drive folder or PDF and share the link. In that folder, also note your total monthly ad spend managed at peak.

Two or three sentences answering this: a landscaping client is getting leads at $35 CPL, but the sales team says 80% of them are tire-kickers who can't afford a $30k job. What do you change first, and why?

Put the word TURF at the start of your subject line so we know you read the full post.

We rank applicants by depth of proof, and that's what d
 where you land in the salary band. More accounts, more spend managed, more time in this niche — all of it moves you up. Applications missing any of these three steps will not be reviewed.

title: Wedding Photo Editor Culler Retoucher

title: Social Media Video Editor
description:
Hi! I'm looking for a part-time video editor, mainly for TikTok and Instagram, to create videos using content I film at events.



I run a growing company in California that rents out a mobile mini golf course for corporate events, weddings, school events, and parties. Find us on 



I'm looking for a creative, independent video editor to help grow my social media presence through engaging, organic short-form content. I'll upload footage to a Google Drive folder, and then your responsibility is to review that footage, identify opportunities for engaging content, and turn it into compelling videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok. 



I'm looking for someone who can take creative ownership of the process with minimal direction. I don't want to provide detailed instructions for every video. I want someone who understands what performs well on social media and can independently create content that people actually want to watch. Experience in paid ads, trial reels etc is a plus. I get 95% of my bookings from paid ads on Instagram so I want to launch on TikTok ASAP and try and get more organic views on both platforms by creating higher quality short form video content. Video editing and social media is not my field of expertise or my passion, so I would rather pay someone else who knows what they're doing, so I can focus on the rest of the business! I do have a working understanding though, and I manage all my own paid ads.



In addition to reviewing footage and editing it into engaging videos, you will also need to add appropriate music, text overlays, captions, transitions, and effects. Using trending audio and formats would be good. Any creative ideas you can suggest would be great - we can film whatever clips you need!



Lastly, you will review video performance in order to continuously improve content based on what generates views and engagement.





Requirements:



- Demonstrated experience editing short-form videos for Instagram and TikTok. Experience creating content for US-based brands, events, entertainment, or lifestyle businesses is a plus.



- Strong understanding of organic social media growth, hooks, storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.



- Excellent written and spoken English, and familiarity with American culture, humor, consumer preferences, and social media trends.



- Ability to work creatively and independently with minimal supervision using your own equipment/software/etc.





This is an opportunity for a long-term working relationship and increased hours as the business grows. If you want a full time job with benefits, this could turn into that in the future, but it will need to start slow for at least the first couple of months. I don't really know how many hours per week we need right now - probably somewhere between 10 and 20 hours will be fine. I care more about high quality results and consistent communication than exactly how long a video took to edit.



I would love to see some short form videos you have edited, including if possible any information on results of videos that have performed well. Please describe your relevant experience and share what you are looking for both in terms of your hourly rate, and how many hours of work per week or per month you are looking for.



Top candidates will be invited to complete a PAID editing test using some of my actual event footage. The selected candidate can start immediately - I move fast, and I communicate clearly, so I'll be sure to keep all applicants updated. Please include "Perfect Nine" in the heading so that I see you read through the description!



If you checked out my Instagram, and you're excited to create entertaining content, experiment with new ideas, and help build my brand's social media presence, please get in touch! 



Thanks!

- Jacob (owner)

title: FULL-TIME META ADS SPECIALIST / MEDIA BUYER
description:
**FULL-TIME META ADS SPECIALIST / MEDIA BUYER**



**Remote | Fixed Monthly Salary | Long-term Agency Role**



Ascante Media is a Bangkok-based marketing agency working with restaurants, fitness businesses and consumer brands.



We’re hiring an experienced, full-time Meta Ads Specialist to manage
 and Instagram advertising across our growing client portfolio.



This is a salaried position. Managing multiple client accounts is part of the role, with responsibilities and workload managed within agreed working hours.



Our team produces the reels, UGC, influencer content and other creative assets. You will own paid advertising strategy, campaign setup, tracking, testing, optimization and reporting.



You’ll start with our initial priority accounts and take responsibility for additional accounts as campaigns become established and capacity allows.



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**



- Advertising strategy and execution across assigned client accounts.

- Daily campaign monitoring, budget pacing and issue resolution.

- Conversion tracking, attribution checks and performance analysis.

- Creative testing and clear briefs for our editors.

- Weekly reports covering spending, results, problems and next actions.

- Organized account documentation and repeatable campaign processes.

- Early communication when workload could affect campaign quality.



**WHAT WE REQUIRE**



- Ideally 3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.

- Experience independently managing multiple client accounts.

- Verifiable examples of campaigns you personally managed.

- Strong creative judgment and understanding of customer acquisition economics.

- Reliable full-time availability with agreed Bangkok business-hours overlap.

- Clear communication and the ability to work without constant supervision.



Restaurant, hospitality, fitness and local-business experience is strongly preferred.



Google Ads and local SEO experience are additional advantages. State your experience in each separately.



**COMPENSATION AND APPLICATION**



Please include:



- Your expected fixed monthly salary in USD

- Your earliest start date.

- Your current employment and freelance commitments.

- Your CV and relevant campaign evidence.

- Your answers to the five assessment questions.



Please also state how many accounts you have personally managed simultaneously, their approximate combined monthly spend, what support you received, and how you maintained campaign quality.



**Selection process:** assessment → interview and live case walkthrough → agreed paid probation period.





FIVE ASSESSMENT QUESTIONS



1. Prove your personal contribution.



Describe your most relevant Meta campaign. Include the business type, market, dates, spend and currency, campaign objective, results and measurement method.



What did you personally manage? What changed because of your decisions? Include supporting evidence and confirm whether you can explain the campaign in a live interview.



2. Explain how you would launch responsibly.



You’re starting with a healthy-food restaurant in Bangkok and a hypothetical THB30,000 monthly media budget.



What information must you collect before spending? Explain your initial offer, customer action, geographic targeting, campaign structure and testing priorities. What would make you pause, continue or increase spending?



3. Show your creative judgment.



Reel A gets 300,000 views, mostly outside Bangkok. Reel B gets 12,000 views and several local enquiries about ordering.



How would you d
 what to test with paid advertising? Give three specific creative variations you would brief to our editors, and explain how you would evaluate them.



4. Diagnose performance and explain the economics.



A campaign spends THB6,000 and records 40 purchases at THB400 each. Each order contributes THB120 before advertising and agency fees.



Would you scale it? Show your calculation and explain what else you would investigate.



How would you check whether the reported purchases are accurate, and how would you handle measurement for walk-ins or third-party delivery orders?



5. Demonstrate judgment when things go wrong.



Describe a campaign that underperformed under your management.



What did you investigate first? What did you change, what happened afterward, and what did you tell the client? What would you do differently today?

title: Appointment Setter – Cold Calling & Lead Follow-Up
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re hiring a confident Appointment Setter to contact prospects, qualify leads, and book appointments for our sales team.



You’ll make outbound calls, follow up with interested prospects, handle initial objections, and keep the appointment calendar organized. Success means booking qualified appointments with people who understand the purpose of the meeting and are interested in learning more.



We welcome applicants with appointment setting, cold calling, telemarketing, inside sales, or outbound sales experience.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Contact prospects through outbound calls,
s, and text messages

- Respond promptly to assigned inbound inquiries

- Ask qualifying questions to understand needs, interest, and fit

- Explain the purpose and value of the appointment clearly

- Handle initial objections and confidently ask for a meeting

- Book appointments based on the sales team’s availability

- Send confirmations and reminders to encourage attendance

- Follow up with unanswered leads, cancellations, and no-shows

- Maintain accurate CRM notes, lead statuses, and follow-up tasks

- Give the sales team clear notes before each appointment

- Track outreach, qualified bookings, and appointment attendance

- Work toward agreed activity and appointment-quality targets



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Previous experience in appointment setting, cold calling, telemarketing, or phone sales

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident, professional phone communication

- Experience qualifying prospects and handling common objections

- Consistent follow-up habits and accurate recordkeeping

- Ability to stay motivated through rejection and unanswered calls

- Comfortable using CRM systems, dialers, and online calendars

- Ability to follow a script while keeping conversations natural

- Availability during U.S. business hours

- Reliable computer, headset, stable internet, and a quiet workspace



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- Calling U.S. customers or businesses

- Managing follow-up sequences and appointment reminders

- Using GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRMs

- Working toward appointment-setting targets with measurable results



COMPENSATION



- $5 USD per hour + commission

- Commission structure and qualifying criteria will be explained during the interview



HOW TO APPLY



Send your updated resume using this subject line:



SETTER – [Years of Relevant Experience] – [Your Name]



Include short answers to these three questions:



1. What product or service did you set appointments for, and were your calls cold, warm, or both?

2. How many qualified appointments did you typically book per week, and how many attended?

3. How do you respond when a prospect says, “Just send me some information”?



Include a 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your most relevant appointment-setting experience.

title: Virtual Assistant – HOA Software & Banking Transitions
description:
About the Role



Are you a detail-oriented professional who doesn’t give up until the job is done? We’re looking for a Virtual Assistant to support community association management companies through major transitions, including moving to new software platforms like CINC and Vantaca and switching their banking relationships. You’ll play a key part in making these changes feel manageable for clients. If you have HOA accounting experience, love organized work, and enjoy seeing tough tasks through to the finish, this could be the right fit for you.



Key Responsibilities



Support HOA software migrations in CINC and Vantaca, including data setup, cleanup, and verification

Assist with banking conversions, such as updating payment information, autopays, and vendor and utility accounts

Navigate utility and vendor portals, track down account access, and work with providers to set up new logins

Handle HOA accounting tasks such as accounts payable, reconciliations, and owner ledger review

Keep project trackers and documentation up to date

Communicate professionally with management company staff, banks, and vendors



Qualifications



- HOA or property management accounting experience

- Hands-on CINC experience is required; Vantaca experience is a big plus

- Strong attention to detail and follow-through, especially on tasks that take persistence

- Highly proficient in Excel

- Clear, friendly written and verbal English

- Quiet work environment suitable for client calls

- Comfortable working independently and asking good questions

- Available during US Eastern business hours (25-30 Hours)



Why Join Us



Meaningful, varied work with management companies across the HOA industry

A supportive, relationship-focused team

Strong security practices, including MFA, endpoint protection, managed IT, and secure file sharing, so you work in a protected environment



How to Apply



Start your message with the phrase “You can count on me” so we know you read the full post. Applications without this phrase will not be entertained.



Your application should include:



1. Résumé (PDF)

Attach your résumé listing your HOA or property management accounting roles, the US-based companies you supported, and the software you used (especially CINC and Vantaca).



2. Video introduction (2–3 minutes)

Record a short video and include the link in your message (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted). Make sure anyone with the link can view it. In the video, cover:



Who you are and your current or most recent role

Your hands-on experience with CINC (and Vantaca, if any)

A time you had to keep following up to get something done, such as account access or a vendor response

Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally and don’t read from a script. We want to hear how you communicate.



3. Written answers to these questions



- How many years have you worked in HOA or property management accounting, and for which types of US-based companies?

- Describe your hands-on experience with CINC. Which tasks have you done in it (e.g., data setup, AP, reconciliations, owner ledgers)? Have you used Vantaca?

- Have you been part of a software migration or banking conversion? Briefly describe your role.

- How do you handle a vendor or utility provider that is slow to respond or won’t give you account access?

- Confirm your availability for US Eastern business hours, your expected monthly compensation in PHP, and your earliest start date.



Incomplete applications, including those missing the résumé, video link, or written answers, will not be considered.

title: AI Video Creator & CapCut Editor (Nano Banana / UGC Ads / Static Ads)
description:
I run several e-commerce brands in the Netherlands (supplements, skincare, home appliances) and I'm looking for one person who can make our ads and content from start to finish using AI tools, and then edit everything in CapCut so it looks like it was shot by a real production team.



This is not a "try AI once in a while" role. You should already be working with these tools every day.



What you will be making:



 • AI video ads that look completely real: real-looking people, real-looking products, natural lighting, no obvious AI glitches. If a viewer can tell it's AI, it's not good enough.

 • UGC-style ads: someone talking to camera about the product, testimonial style, unboxing, before/after. Made with AI, but it has to feel like a real customer filmed it on her phone.

 • Static ads for Meta and TikTok: product shots, before/after images, comparison images, testimonial cards.

 • Educational content: short explainer videos and carousels about the problem our product solves (for example bloating, cravings, skincare).

 • Full editing in CapCut: cuts, captions, hooks in the first second, b-roll, sound design, zooms, transitions, text overlays. Everything has to look sharp and professional. No template look.



Tools you must be very good with:



 • Nano Banana (Google's image model) for generating and editing images and product shots. You should know how to keep a product and a person consistent across many images.

 • CapCut (desktop) at an advanced level. Not just trimming clips: you know captions, keyframes, masks, speed ramps, audio mixing and color.

 • AI video tools such as Kling, Veo, Seedance or Higgsfield for turning images into video.

 • Nice to have: Photoshop or Canva, ElevenLabs for voice-overs, basic Meta Ads knowledge so you understand what performs.



What I expect from you:



 • You can take a product photo and a short brief and come back with a finished ad without me explaining every step.

 • You get the product and brand looking the same in every image and video.

 • You have an eye for what performs on TikTok and Meta right now and you follow trends and new AI tools on your own.

 • You give honest input when something won't work and you suggest better ideas.

 • English communication is good enough to understand briefs and write captions.

 • You work with deadlines and keep me updated without me having to chase you.



How we work:



 • Start with a small paid test project. If it's good, we continue long term.

 • Flexible hours, but I need to be able to reach you on weekdays (Netherlands time, CET).

 • We communicate via WhatsApp or Slack and share files through Google Drive.

 • Long term and steady work for the right person. I run multiple brands, so there is always something to make.



How to apply:



Send me 3 to 5 examples of AI ads or content you made yourself. At least one must be an AI video ad with a realistic person in it, and at least one must be something you edited in CapCut. Links to Google Drive, TikTok or Instagram are fine. Tell me which tools you used for each example.



Applications without examples will not be read.



To make sure you've read this whole post, start your application with the word MANGO. Applications that don't start with that word will be ignored.

title: Accounting and Finance Manager
description:
About the Company

Beyond the Books is a corporate accounting services firm that provides reliable bookkeeping, CFO services, financial analysis, and accounting support for growing businesses. The company’s mission is to help small businesses strengthen their financial health through accurate, dependable, and tailored accounting solutions.



Beyond the Books is a separate entity under the same leadership as Horizon Advisors. While Horizon Advisors provides advisory and technical accounting services such as SOX implementation, IPO readiness, technical accounting, and complex financial advisory, Beyond the Books focuses on ongoing accounting operations and financial support for U.S.-based clients.



Beyond the Books supports clients through bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end close, financial reporting, cleanup projects, financial analysis, and controller-level accounting support.



We are built on high standards, ownership, and teamwork. Our success comes from combining initiative with discipline, accuracy, and clear communication. We believe excellence is achieved when people take ownership of their work, communicate proactively, and consistently deliver accurate, reliable results.



Our Core Values

* Teamwork – We work as one team, valuing clarity, mutual respect, and accountability.

* Positive Attitude – We stay solution-oriented, professional, and calm under pressure.

* Integrity – We uphold accuracy, honesty, and transparency in everything we do.

* Commitment – We take ownership and follow through until results are achieved.

* Customer Experience – We build trust by delivering structured, dependable, and thoughtful service.



Job Overview

We are seeking an analytical, detail-oriented, and highly dependable Accounting and Finance Manager to oversee client accounting engagements for Beyond the Books and ensure accurate, timely, and reliable financial support for U.S.-based clients.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys technical accounting work, careful review, process improvement, and solving complex accounting issues with accuracy and consistency. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a structured remote environment, reviewing work thoroughly, identifying errors or gaps, and maintaining high standards across client accounts.



The right person will bring strong accounting judgment, deep attention to detail, and the discipline to ensure deliverables are complete, accurate, and compliant with U.S. GAAP.



Key Responsibilities

- Serve as the accounting lead for select Beyond the Books client accounts, providing technical review and guidance as needed.

- Oversee bookkeeping, reconciliations, month-end close, financial reporting, and cleanup work as needed.

- Review client deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with U.S. GAAP.

- Prepare and review financial reports, management reports, reconciliations, and other client-facing accounting deliverables.

- Analyze accounting issues, reporting discrepancies, and process gaps, then recommend practical and accurate solutions.

- Maintain clean accounting processes, documentation, reporting timelines, and quality control standards across client accounts.

- Support onboarding for new clients by reviewing existing accounting records, identifying cleanup needs, and helping establish reliable accounting workflows.

- Coordinate with internal tea ---------- mbers to ensure client work is completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule.

- Communicate clearly with internal teams and client stakeholders regarding accounting findings, reporting issues, and recommended next steps.

- Maintain a high level of accuracy, follow-through, and technical consistency across all client engagements.



Why Join Us?

- Be part of a firm that values results, accuracy, and integrity.

- Work directly with leadership to implement financial best practices and automation initiatives.

- Gain exposure to diverse industries while maintaining stability and structure in your work.

- Enjoy a 100% remote setup with defined expectations and transparent communication.

- Grow in a culture that rewards proactive thinking, discipline, and dependability.



Compensation

- Full-time role at $15 per hour.

- Paid Time Off (PTO) – accrued and available as earned.

- Health Insurance – available after 3 months of continuous employment.

- Performance-based increases and consistent long-term growth opportunities.



Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required.

- CPA license, active or inactive, required.

- Big 4 public accounting experience required.

- Minimum 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including full-cycle accounting, month-end close, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

- Prior experience supporting U.S.-based companies or clients.

- Strong proficiency in QuickBooks and Microsoft Excel.

- Deep knowledge of U.S. GAAP, internal controls, reconciliations, and technical accounting standards.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and process gaps.

- Exceptional attention to detail and high personal accountability.

- Ability to work independently in a structured remote environment.

- Clear and professional communication skills with internal teams and client stakeholders.

- Reliable, consistent, and quality-focused in all aspects of work.



Application Instruction

To be considered, please put “ACCURACY” in the subject line of your application and answer the question below in 2 to 3 sentences:



Why is attention to detail critical in accounting work?



Only applications that follow this instruction will be reviewed.

title: Affiliate Program Manager - Build & Scale (Amazon Supplement Brand, $10M+) | $1,800 Base + Uncapped Bonus
description:
ABOUT US

Nutra Wave is a Health Canada certified supplement brand doing $10M+ a year, mostly on Amazon Canada, plus Amazon US and Australia, Walmart and our own Shopify store. Established, profitable and growing.



We don't have a working affiliate program yet. That's the job: build it, run it, and scale it profitably. You'll report directly to the founder and be accountable for the revenue number.



PAY

- $1,800/month base salary

- Monthly performance bonus tied to the affiliate revenue you drive at a profitable cost. Top performers earn $3,800+/month, and the bonus is uncapped.

- Base salary review at 6 months for people hitting targets

- Full bonus structure shared at the interview stage



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Set up and run our Amazon affiliate channels (Levanta, Amazon Creator Connections, Amazon Associates) for Canada and the US, then our TikTok Shop US affiliate program

- Design the commission structure and program economics so it scales profitably, not just big

- Recruit affiliates and creators in health, wellness and supplements. This is the bulk of the work in the first 90 days: high-volume personalized outreach and relentless follow-up

- Onboard affiliates: commission terms, samples, content briefs, brand guidelines. Keep them active after sign-up, which is where most programs die

- Track everything at the affiliate level: sales, conversions, commission cost, and program cost as a % of sales

- Send one clear weekly report to the founder, led by three numbers

- Keep creator content compliant with supplement claim rules (we'll train you, we take it seriously)



MUST-HAVES (applications without these won't be considered)

- You've personally set up an affiliate or creator program: commissions, tracking and terms. Not just ran someone else's

- You can name the monthly revenue your best program produced

- Hands-on experience in at least one of: Levanta, Amazon Creator Connections, Amazon Associates, Impact, Awin, CJ, ShareASale or Refersion

- You're comfortable being paid on results



NICE TO HAVE

- Supplement, health or wellness brand experience

- TikTok Shop affiliate experience

- Amazon Seller Central or Amazon Attribution familiarity



WHO THIS ISN'T FOR

General VAs adding a skill. Social media managers. Anyone whose experience is only influencer gifting with no commissions or tracking.



SCHEDULE AND BOUNDARIES

- Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday, long-term

- Online and responsive 9am to 1pm Eastern Time daily. The rest of your hours are flexible

- Exclusive role: no other clients or part-time jobs while working with us

- Time tracking required

- Weekly 1:1 call with the founder



HIRING PROCESS

1. Written application (below)

2. 45-minute interview

3. Reference check: be ready to provide two references who managed or worked with you on an affiliate program, at least one a manager or client (not a colleague). We will contact them.

4. Paid test task (about 2 hours), paid either way

5. Offer, including your 90-day build plan and the full bonus structure



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully, applications that skip any step are deleted without a reply)

1. Start your message with the word COMMISSION

2. Answer these five questions, short and direct:

   a) Which affiliate or creator platforms have you personally logged into and worked in? Name them.

   b) Describe the best program you built or ran: brand, number of active affiliates, and its MONTHLY REVENUE.

   c) What commission rate and total program cost (as a % of sales) did that program run at?

   d) What's the first thing you'd do in week one at a brand with no affiliate program?

   e) Are you currently working with any other clients? Can you commit exclusively?

3. State your expected base salary.



No cover letters. No generic pitches. Just the answers.
