Barrister Premier Properties, LLC is seeking an experienced, hands-on Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager to take ownership of maintenance and field operations across our portfolio of multifamily apartments, hotels, shopping centers, commercial properties, and tenant spaces throughout the Northshore.



We are looking for someone with strong construction and property maintenance experience who can diagnose problems, determine the correct repair solution, lead a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew, manage work orders, procure materials, and personally perform or assist with repairs when needed.



Key Responsibilities



-Manage, assign, prioritize, and track daily maintenance work orders.

-Lead, supervise, and hold accountable a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew.

-Diagnose building, construction, and maintenance issues and determine the appropriate repair solution.

-Create scopes of work, material lists, and basic material takeoffs.

-Purchase and stage materials ahead of scheduled work and respond quickly to emergency material needs.

-Perform hands-on repairs and maintenance alongside the crew when necessary.

-Conduct regular property walks and inspections to identify maintenance needs before they become larger problems.

-Perform tenant and resident move-out inspections and coordinate turnover work.

-Establish and maintain preventative maintenance schedules across the portfolio.

-Respond to emergency maintenance issues and prioritize work based on urgency, safety, property damage exposure, and operational impact.

-Track outstanding repairs and ensure work is completed properly, timely, and to company standards.

-Coordinate with outside subcontractors when work requires specialized trades or additional manpower.

-Verify completed work and maintain accountability for quality, materials, labor, and company resources.

-Take full ownership of maintenance issues from initial diagnosis through final completion.



Qualifications



-5+ years of experience in construction, property maintenance, facilities maintenance, or maintenance supervision.

-Strong working knowledge of multiple trades, including:

            -Carpentry and general construction

            -Plumbing

            -Electrical

            -HVAC

            -Drywall

            -Painting and finishes

-Proven ability to lead and manage maintenance or construction personnel.

-Experience preparing scopes of work, material takeoffs, and purchasing materials.

-Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.

-Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple active work orders and properties simultaneously.

-Comfortable working in the field daily and performing hands-on work when required.

-Reliable transportation and a clean driving record.

-Strong communication skills and professional presence when interacting with tenants, residents, vendors, subcontractors, and company personnel.



Ideal Candidate



-We are looking for someone who is hands-on, dependable, organized, decisive, and accountable.

-The right candidate should be able to walk into a property, identify the problem, determine the appropriate solution, obtain the necessary materials, assign or perform the work, and make sure the job is completed correctly.

-You should be comfortable making decisions in the field, working under pressure, managing competing priorities, leading a crew, and treating company properties, materials, equipment, and resources as if they were your own.

-We want someone who does not simply identify problems or pass them along. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the problem and drives it through completion.

-This position is critical to establishing and maintaining a reliable, organized, responsive, and accountable in-house property maintenance operation across the Barrister Premier Properties portfolio.

title: Part-Time Appointment Setter (US Business Calls) - Roofing - Mon to Fri, 4 Hours a Day
description:
Grandma Roofer is a roofing company in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, Texas.

We help churches, property managers and building owners keep their

roofs in good shape.

We offer a free roof look with photos. Nothing up front.



THE JOB

You will phone business offices in Texas and set up a short, free

roof-look visit.

You are an appointment setter. Your only goal is to book the visit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Make about 40 to 60 calls a day from a call list we give you.

- Use our short script. Stay on script.

- Ask who looks after the roofs at the building.

- Ask simple quote questions: roof size and type, any leaks, who makes

the decision, timeline, and budget window.

- Never give a price. Say: "Cindy gives prices after the free roof look."

- Offer two visit times. Book one.

- Log the result of every call in a Google Sheet (we give you the codes).

- Leave a short voi
 (live voice only) when nobody answers.

- Say "This call may be recorded" at the start of every call.

- If someone says "stop calling" or "do not call", log DNC right away.

- Send a short end-of-day summary in the sheet.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No quoting prices. No selling. No taking payment.

- No promises or guarantees about the roof or the work.

- No claims about the company beyond the script.

- No texting or
ing prospects.

- No calling anyone not on your list.

- Book the visit only. The owner handles everything after that.



PAY

- $5 to $7 per hour, based on your voice test and phone screen. Paid

weekly or every two weeks.

- Plus $15 for every visit that is kept (the visit happens and we meet

the decision-maker).

- One-month trial. The first week is a paid trial at your hourly rate.

- We review your work every Friday. If it goes well, you continue.

- 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday. About 20 hours a week.

- No weekend calls.



SCHEDULE

- Monday to Friday, 4 hours a day.

- Calls are made between 9 AM and 5 PM Central Time (US).

- Starting block: 9 AM to 1 PM Central. That is 10 PM to 2 AM

Philippine time now, and 11 PM to 3 AM after US clocks change on Nov

1.

- If you cannot work these hours, please do not apply.



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent, clear English. Native-level or near-native.

- Neutral, very light accent. Easy for Americans to understand on the phone.

- Upbeat, warm and friendly. We should hear your smile on the phone.

- REQUIRED: a 60-second voice recording reading the test script (see

"How to apply").

- REQUIRED: a short live phone screen if you are shortlisted.

- Quiet room. Good headset. Stable internet (wired is best).

- A laptop or desktop that runs Chrome.

- Comfortable making phone calls to businesses and hearing "no" politely.

- Reliable. You show up every shift.

- US call-center experience preferred (cold calling or appointment setting).



HOW TO APPLY (follow every step or we will skip your application)

1. Use the subject line: ROOF CALLER - [Your Name]

2. Answer the 5 questions below.

3. Attach (or link) a 60-second voice recording of the test script below.

4. Tell us your hourly rate and your available hours.

5. If shortlisted, be ready for a short live phone screen.



5 SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Which US businesses have you called before, and what was your job?

(If none, say "none" and tell us why you would be good at this.)

2. A church secretary says, "We're not interested." What do you say

next? Write your exact words.

3. A property manager says, "What does it cost?" You may not quote

prices. What do you say? Write your exact words.

4. The person says, "Please stop calling me." What do you do?

5. This job is 9 AM to 1 PM Central, Monday to Friday. What are your

hours in the Philippines, and can you work them every day with a quiet

room and wired internet?



AUDIO TEST SCRIPT (read out loud, about 60 seconds, record it, one take is fine)

Say it the way you would on a real call. Smile. Speak slowly and clearly.



"Hi, this is [your first name], calling for Cindy at Grandma Roofer.

This call may be recorded.

Do you have a minute? I'll be quick.

We're giving churches and property managers in Benbrook a free roof

look with photos.

Who looks after the roofs at your building?

About how big is the roof, and what kind is it? Any leaks right now?

Is there a timeline or budget window you're working with?

Cindy gives prices after the free roof look.

Could we schedule a 20-minute visit? Nothing up front. We just leave

you the photos.

I have Tuesday at 10 AM, or Wednesday at 2 PM. Which works better?"



Then answer this one in your own words (10 seconds):

The person says: "We already have a roofer."



SHOW YOUR WORK (we listen for)

- Excellent, clear English with a neutral, light accent.

- Upbeat, warm and friendly, with a smile we can hear.

- Clear words and a friendly tone.

- Not too fast. Not reading like a robot.

- Smooth handling of "We already have a roofer."

- Quiet background. No echo.

title: Behavioral Health Medical Billing Specialist
description:
Behavioral Health Medical Billing Specialist



**Position Type:** Part time 

**Experience Required:** Minimum of 3 years of behavioral health medical billing experience



### Important Qualification Requirements



Applicants must have hands-on experience with TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health electronic health record (EHR) systems.



**Candidates must have at least 3 years of relevant experience to be considered. Applicants without the required experience will not be considered.**



### Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented and dependable Behavioral Health Medical Billing Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience with outpatient mental health billing, insurance claims, accounts receivable (AR), and denial management.



In this role, you will communicate with patients, coworkers, and insurance companies to maintain accurate billing records, resolve outstanding balances, and ensure timely reimbursement. You will review patient records, referrals, explanations of benefits (EOBs), and other documentation to verify billing accuracy and resolve claim discrepancies.



### Key Responsibilities



The Billing Specialist will submit and manage insurance claims for outpatient behavioral health services, perform accounts receivable follow-up, and monitor aging reports. Responsibilities include contacting insurance companies to investigate unpaid, rejected, and denied claims; reviewing EOBs to identify reimbursement discrepancies, contractual adjustments, and patient responsibility; and researching claim denials, correcting billing errors, and submitting appeals when appropriate.



The specialist will identify recurring denial trends and recommend strategies to reduce future denials. Additional responsibilities include verifying insurance benefits, reviewing patient billing information for accuracy, maintaining detailed account notes within TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health EHR systems, and communicating professionally with patients, providers, coworkers, and insurance representatives.



The ideal candidate must follow established billing procedures, maintain patient confidentiality, and ensure accurate documentation throughout the revenue cycle process.



### Required Qualifications



Candidates must have a minimum of 3 years of behavioral health medical billing experience, with hands-on experience using TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, and other mental health EHR systems. Experience with insurance claims submission, payment posting, accounts receivable follow-up, and denial management is required.



Applicants must have a strong understanding of ICD-10 codes, CPT codes, medical terminology, behavioral health billing practices, and insurance reimbursement procedures. The ability to read and interpret EOBs, investigate claim denials, and communicate effectively with insurance representatives is essential.



Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, is required. Candidates must demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Applicants must also be willing to complete initial training and participate in refresher training as needed.



### Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with commercial insurance plans, Medicare, and TRICARE is preferred. Familiarity with insurance eligibility verification, coordination of benefits (COB), contractual fee schedules, underpayment investigations, and claim reprocessing is highly desirable. Knowledge of behavioral health revenue cycle management is also preferred.



We are looking for a reliable, experienced, and detail-oriented professional who is committed to maintaining accurate billing records, resolving insurance issues, and supporting the financial health of a behavioral health practice.



### How to Apply



Please submit your résumé highlighting your behavioral health billing experience and mental health EHR systems.

title: DM setter
description:
**Title:**

Instagram DM Appointment Setter for Photography Coaching Brand (Eastern Time, Full-Time)



**Announcement:**

Hiring an English-fluent Instagram DM setter to turn warm leads into booked sales calls for a photography educator with 400,000+ Instagram followers. Inbound leads only, no cold outreach. Base pay plus a bonus for every qualified call booked.



**Description:**



I'm Serge Ramelli, a photographer and online educator with 400,000+ followers on Instagram and 650,000 on YouTube. I sell a high-end photography coaching program ($3,000 to $5,000) that teaches people Lightroom, Photoshop, composition, and landscape, cityscape, and wildlife photography.



Every day, hundreds of people message us on Instagram, comment on reels, or download our free presets. Right now only 10 to 20% of them end up in a real conversation. Your job is to change that.



**What you will do:**

- Reply to inbound Instagram DMs and comments in a warm, natural, human way

- Start conversations with new followers and people who downloaded our free presets

- Follow up with people who don't answer (2 to 3 messages over 24 hours, then again days later)

- Ask simple questions to understand their photography goals, then book qualified people on a call with our sales team

- Work alongside our AI setter, taking over the conversations it can't move forward

- Track every conversation and booking in a simple daily report



**Who our leads are:**

Mostly people 50 and older, many retired, who own a good camera ($2,000 to $3,000) but don't know how to use it well or edit their photos. They need patience, respect, and a friendly tone, not pushy sales talk.



**What we're looking for:**

- Excellent written English (this is the most important skill)

- At least 1 year of experience as a DM setter or appointment setter, ideally for a coaching or online course business

- Comfortable working United States Eastern Time hours (Florida)

- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

- Bonus if you love photography or know Lightroom



**Pay:**

- $600 to $900 per month base, depending on experience

- Plus a bonus for every qualified call booked that shows up

- Long-term, full-time position with room to grow



**How to apply:**

1. Start your application with the word "GOLDEN HOUR" so we know you read this.

2. Tell us about your setting experience and how many calls you booked per day in your last role.

3. Write a short reply to this DM: "Hi Serge, I got your free presets but I don't really know how to use them. I'm retired and just bought a Sony camera."

4. Send a short voice or video recording introducing yourself (1 minute maximum).



Applications without all 4 steps will not be reviewed.

title: Google flow/Veo3 video editor   AI Video Generation
description:
AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor — Veo 3, Nano Banana, CapCut, Elevenlabs, ChatGPT

Create health and wellness reels and UGC videos.



I run a fast-growing
 and Instagram health and wellness brand built around a consistent AI avatar, along with a growing network of additional social media pages.



I am looking for an **experienced AI video creator and editor** who can take a script and turn it into high-quality, realistic short-form content from start to finish.



**This is NOT a training role.**



You should already be comfortable working with the tools below and be able to start producing quality content with minimal hand-holding.



The three biggest things I care about are:



* **Following instructions exactly**

* **Making the videos look as realistic as possible**

* **Communicating clearly and consistently**



If I provide a reference video, avatar image, product image, editing example, or specific instructions, I expect those details to be followed closely.



## TOOLS YOU MUST ALREADY KNOW



### Veo 3 / Google Flow / Capcut



You should know how to:



* Generate high-quality, photorealistic AI videos from written prompts

* Create realistic human movement, expressions, gestures, and speech

* Maintain consistent characters between clips

* Create vertical short-form content ready for Instagram and

* Match the pacing, camera angles, movements, and overall feel of reference videos

* Troubleshoot poor generations and improve prompts without needing constant guidance



### Veo3 / Nano Banana



You should have strong experience with:



* Nano Banana 1

* Nano Banana 2

* Nano Banana Pro

* Veo3

* Google Flow image generation and video generation

*Capcut



You should understand when to use each model depending on the task.



You must be able to generate **hyper-realistic images** while maintaining:



* Consistent facial identity

* Accurate clothing

* Accurate products

* Realistic hands

* Realistic skin texture

* Natural lighting

* Correct proportions

* Consistent environments



The goal is for viewers to have difficulty immediately recognizing that the content is AI-generated.



### CapCut



You should be highly comfortable editing short-form vertical content in CapCut.



You should know how to:



* Match a reference video's editing style closely

* Add and style captions

* Match fonts, placement, sizing, and timing

* Sync music properly

* Remove dead space

* Create tight cuts

* Color correct footage

* Match pacing

* Add overlays and product comparisons

* Make AI-generated footage feel like natural creator content



If I send you a reference video, you should be able to study it and recreate the editing style without needing every small detail explained.



---



# DAILY WORKFLOW



You will receive a script along with any necessary instructions, reference videos, avatar images, product images, or inspiration.



From there, you handle the entire production process:



**Script → Image Generation → Video Generation → Voice → Editing → Finished Video**



This includes:



1. Generating the necessary images with Nano Banana/Higgsfield

2. Creating realistic clips using Veo 3, Flow, HeyGen, or Grok

3. Keeping the avatar consistent

4. Keeping the voice consistent

5. Creating realistic product shots

6. Editing everything together in CapCut

7. Adding captions, music, overlays, and pacing

8. Delivering a finished vertical video that is ready to post



You must be able to deliver a **minimum of 6 finished videos per day**, approximately **5–6 days per week**.



Once you understand the format and style, the workflow is designed to be fast and repeatable.



---



# REALISM IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



I do not want videos that look like polished AI commercials.



Most of the content should feel like a real person casually filming on an iPhone.



That means paying attention to small details such as:



* Natural facial expressions

* Realistic blinking

* Natural hand gestures

* Realistic product handling

* Correct fingers and hands

* Slight camera movement

* Natural body movement

* Realistic lighting

* Accurate product packaging

* Consistent environments

* Consistent avatar appearance

* Consistent voice

* Natural speech pacing



You should notice these problems yourself and fix them rather than waiting for me to point out every issue.



---



# FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



I will often provide very specific instructions about:



* Avatar appearance

* Clothing

* Store/location

* Camera angles

* Product placement

* Product images

* Dialogue

* Voice

* Editing

* Captions

* Reference videos

* Clip pacing



I need someone who actually reads everything carefully and follows those instructions.



If I say to use a specific reference product, store, avatar, voice, or editing style, I should not have to repeat it several times.



Attention to detail is extremely important.



---



# COMMUNICATION



You must be:



* Reliable

* Responsive

* Organized

* Easy to communicate with

* Comfortable asking a question when something is genuinely unclear

* Able to provide updates when needed

* Able to receive feedback without taking it personally

* Able to quickly correct mistakes



If there is a problem with a generation, missing asset, tool issue, or deadline, communicate it immediately instead of disappearing.



I am looking for someone I can work with consistently and trust with a high volume of content.



---



# WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



You should have:



* Proven hands-on experience with **Veo 3**

* Experience with **Google Flow**

* Deep familiarity with **Nano Banana 1, Nano Banana 2, and Nano Banana Pro**

* Strong **CapCut** editing skills

* Strong prompt-writing ability

* Ability to maintain consistent AI characters

* Ability to generate realistic product shots

* Ability to recreate reference videos

* Ability to create completely new video concepts from scripts and inspiration

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow detailed instructions

* Strong attention to realism

* Strong communication

* High output capacity



You must be able to produce **3-4+ finished videos per day, 5–6 days per week.**



---



# WHEN APPLYING



Please include:



* Examples of AI videos you have personally created

* Examples using Veo 3

* Examples of Nano Banana

* Examples of realistic AI avatars

* Examples of short-form editing

* Examples showing realistic product placement or product handling if available



Also briefly explain which tools you use most often and your experience with:



**Veo 3, Google Flow, Nano Banana 1/2/Pro, Chatgpt, and CapCut.**



I am looking for someone who can come in and **produce high-quality content from day one.**

title: Operations & Administration VA | Electrical Trades, SOP Building
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, verifiable operations or EA experience, ideally from a trades or construction business, and demonstrable SOP-building skills will be prioritised for this role.



An electrical business needs a self-directed, operations-first VA to take ownership of business administration, job management and SOP documentation. The role is operations and administration-led, not marketing-led — social media and website work remain part of the role, but at a scheduling and execution level, with content strategy handled by an external specialist. This is a strong, self-directed operator role: both directors want someone who takes a task, owns it completely, and delivers without needing to be followed up — someone who pushes back, asks good questions, and suggests a better way when they see one.



The role starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with the expectation this grows to full-time reasonably quickly as more tasks are handed over. A broader goal is a fully documented, less founder-dependent business that could run — or be sold — without day-to-day founder involvement by the end of 2027.



What You’ll Own



Operations, Administration & SOP-Building (Primary Focus)



General business administration support: assisting with quotes, invoicing for jobs, and timesheet administration in preparation for payroll

Contribute to building a fully documented, less founder-dependent business

Build out SOPs directly in Asana as processes are established, breaking each task down with the responsible person, day, and expected duration



Job Management (Katipolt)



Manage the back end of the job management platform: job cards, materials uploads, scheduling support, and related workflow

Draft invoices on job completion for maintenance and smaller jobs

Support quoting in the platform

Assist with materials coordination, including checking supplier deliveries and confirming gear is ready for upcoming jobs



Process Documentation



Document new workflows and processes as they’re refined and established — building the SOP library directly off live processes

Store and link all SOPs in Asana, accessible via the mobile app so field-based staff can reference them

Set a quarterly SOP review cadence to keep documentation accurate as the business evolves



 & Customer Communication



Monitor the inbox for customer replies to the business’s automated follow-up sequence, respond where appropriate, and close the loop in the system

Support customer communication throughout the job lifecycle, from initial enquiry through to job completion and follow-up

Manage customer comms within the job platform where possible



Social Media & Website (Scheduling-Level, Not Strategist-Level)



Receive approved content and manage scheduling and light repurposing (e.g. turning a video into a carousel or still-image post) across Instagram,
 and 
 using Meta Business Suite

Update and maintain the WordPress website with minor copy and photo changes as directed — no major redesign or SEO landing-page work required



Business Development & Lead Pipeline



Build and manage a lead pipeline in Asana, moving prospects through stages from initial enquiry to converted client

Manage and improve the quote follow-up process, ensuring no opportunities go cold without contact

Develop and document customer journey touchpoints: enquiry, quote, job commencement, completion, and follow-up/review request

Support outreach and marketing materials as directed



Task & Communication Management



Send a morning WhatsApp message each day with planned priorities

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items requiring attention or approval

Manage the Asana task board across daily, weekly and monthly cadences

Record training calls and use the recordings, plus AI tools, to generate SOP drafts

Participate in regular video calls, including impromptu calls while a director is on the road



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Strong general business administration or EA background, with trades or construction industry exposure strongly preferred

Experience with business process documentation or SOP creation, ideally including breaking tasks into responsibility, cadence and time-per-task

Experience with job management, CRM or trades platforms (Simpro, ServiceM8, Tradify or WunderBuild experience is highly transferable)

Experience drafting invoices, supporting quoting processes, or managing job administration in a service business



Technical Proficiency (Core, Non-Negotiable)



Asana: experience or strong ability to set up and manage task boards, project pipelines and linked SOPs

Microsoft 365/Teams: comfortable with Outlook
, Teams video and associated tools

Confident, fast learner on job management or trades platforms

AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT): genuine, proactive curiosity, not just baseline familiarity — actively pushes their own use of these tools rather than waiting to be shown

Strong written English for professional, client-facing communications



Technical Proficiency (Nice-to-Have)



Instagram and
 scheduling and 
 via Meta Business Suite

LinkedIn page-building experience from a low base

WordPress: minor content and photo updates; SEO/landing-page skills are a bonus

Xero experience is valuable but not mandatory for day one



Communication & Independence



Proactive, not passive — raises questions, confirms understanding, and flags issues before they become problems

Earns trust quickly with busy, selective directors

Confident enough to suggest a better way and push back constructively

Comfortable on frequent video calls, including impromptu check-ins



Organisational Skills



Manages multiple concurrent workstreams (admin, job platform,
 follow-up, SOP creation, light social scheduling) without dropping the ball

Strong self-directed time management within a 4-hour daily shift

Captures tasks, ideas and follow-up items in Asana unprompted



Non-Negotiables



Demonstrable, verifiable experience — real work samples and portfolio evidence are required, not just a strong interview

Consistent performance under sustained, low-supervision conditions, week after week — not just in the first few weeks

Process-minded: sees a repeatable task and thinks about how to document it, who owns it, and how long it should take

Comfortable with ambiguity — many processes are still being built in real time, and the VA helps create them, not just follow them

Treats every output — a caption, a quote, a drafted invoice — as representing an established, 19-year business

Fast learner on new platforms, particularly the job management system and Asana



Working Arrangements



Starts at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday to Friday), with a realistic path to full-time as more tasks are handed over

Regular video calls, including impromptu check-ins while a director is on the road



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of operations and SOP-building in a business actively working to become less founder-dependent

Real trust extended quickly to someone who proves they can be handed something and not need chasing

A business actively building AI into how it works, with room to bring your own ideas and curiosity

Growth-oriented environment with a clear path to more responsibility as the role and the business evolve

title: Tenant Lead Generation in UK
description:
About the role

I’m a self-employed letting agent in the UK with access to 700+ rental properties, both rooms and whole apartments. I’m looking for an experienced lead generator to find serious tenants, qualify them, and book viewings so we can close lets together.



You’ll earn a monthly base plus a bonus for every completed let you help produce. I need someone who already knows how to do this and can start without training.



What you’ll do



Find people looking to rent in the UK, using the platforms and channels you know work best for UK tenants, and post and manage listings on my accounts

Reply quickly to enquiries

Qualify leads: budget, move-in date, tenancy length, employment/income, number of occupants

Book and confirm viewings in my calendar

Send reminders and follow up with leads who go quiet

Track activity in a simple spreadsheet and send a short weekly report



Targets



8-12 qualified viewings that actually take place each month

1-2 completed lets per month to start, with no cap on bonuses



Requirements



Proven experience in lead generation, lettings or real estate, sales or appointment setting (UK property experience is a big plus)

Excellent written English and a friendly, professional tone

Available for at least 15-20 hours per week, with overlap with UK hours (9am-6pm)

Fast response times and reliable internet

Self-starter who works well without close supervision



Pay



Base: $275/month (part-time, about 15-20 hours/week)

Bonus: $200 for every completed room let and $250 for every completed apartment let, paid once the fee has been received. No cap: the more lets you close, the more you earn.

Trial: the first 4 weeks are a paid trial with clear targets (leads contacted, viewings booked, viewings attended). If it’s going well, we continue long term, and the base pay will increase once lets are coming in.



The base is modest because the bonus is strong. This suits someone confident in their results who wants to grow with the role.



To apply, please answer:



Describe your experience finding tenants, leads or customers online, with any results you achieved.

Which platforms would you use to find UK tenants, and why?

How many hours per week can you commit, and what hours will you be working?

Start your message with the word “Mango” so I know you read this to the end.
